Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_count1 number;
 temp_batch_ID VARCHAR2(14);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_unit.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 select count(*) into temp_count1 from arc_log_det
 where
 unit_id=:ctrl_unit.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 :ctrl_unit.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_unit.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_unit.s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 if temp_count1 > 0 then
 show_error('0214');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 IF :ctrl_unit.coll_date is null THEN
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_unit.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if :ctrl_unit.coll_date is null
 then
 :ctrl_unit.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_unit.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_unit.s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 

 -- Bag checkin check;
 DECLARE
 CURSOR bag_chkin_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_ID
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 AND batch_id IS NOT NULL;
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN; 
 BEGIN
 OPEN bag_chkin_cur;
 FETCH bag_chkin_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := bag_chkin_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE bag_chkin_cur;
 
 IF NOT l_recFound THEN 
 show_error('0440');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 
 :ctrl_unit.chapter_ID := :GLOBAL.chapter_ID; 
 
end;

DECLARE

 FROM master_codes mc
 WHERE mc.code_type = 'PARDT'

declare
 PROCEDURE set_update_ITEMS IS
 BEGIN
 IF :CTRL_UNIT.S_PROD_CAT = 'PLT' THEN
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.SUSPENSION_TYPE','E');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.INIT_PLT_COUNT','E');
 END IF; 

 item_change('PR_DETAILS.INITIAL_PROD_WEIGHT','E');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.INITIAL_PROD_VOL','E');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.ANTICOAGULANT_VOLUME','E'); 
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.PROCESS_DATE_TIME','E'); 

 item_change('PR_DETAILS.EQUIP_TYPE','D');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.RBC_ACC','D');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.RBC_NOT_ACC','D');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.VOL_TYPE_SET','D');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.S_AGGR_ACC','D'); 
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.S_AGGR_NOT_ACC','D');
 item_change('PR_DETAILS.SUIT_PROD_CODE','D');
 END set_update_ITEMS;

begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_unit.s_prod_code is null then
 
 
 SUIT_CHECK;


 -- update mode check when initial_prod_Code is null;
 DECLARE
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 BEGIN
 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := FALSE;
 
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_cnt
 FROM valid_products v, pathogen_reduction_details prd, components c
 WHERE v.product_code = SUBSTR(prd.suit_prod_code, 1, 5)
 AND c.product_code = prd.suit_prod_code
 AND prd.suit_prod_code IS NOT NULL
 -- AND c.reject_reason_code IS NULL
 AND NVL(v.pathogen_reduction_flag ,'N') = 'Y'
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I' 
 AND prd.unit_ID = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND prd.unit_id = c.unit_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN v.eff_date AND NVL(v.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 
 IF ln_cnt <> 0 THEN
 IF :FORMS_VAR.PRUP_ACCESS = 'N' THEN
 show_error('0478');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := TRUE;
 END IF; 

 IF GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode THEN
 set_update_ITEMS;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PR_DETAILS_CTRL.PB_SAVE', LABEL, 'Update');
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PR_DETAILS_CTRL.PB_SAVE', LABEL, 'Save');
 END IF;


 END;
 
 

 
 
 
 IF get_item_property('pr_details.suspension_type', NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pr_details.suspension_type');
 ELSIF get_item_property('pr_details.initial_prod_weight', NAVIGABLE) ='TRUE' THEN 
 GO_ITEM('pr_details.initial_prod_weight');
 ELSIF get_item_property('pr_details.initial_prod_vol', NAVIGABLE) ='TRUE' THEN 
 GO_ITEM('pr_details.initial_prod_vol');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('pr_details.rbc_acc');
 END IF;
 else
 if UPPER(:ctrl_unit.s_prod_code) != 'M'
 then
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ctrl_unit.prod_code',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ctrl_unit.prod_code', UPDATE_NULL, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 go_item('ctrl_unit.prod_code');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 else
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ctrl_unit.prod_code',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ctrl_unit.prod_code', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 --NEXT_ITEM;
 go_item('ctrl_unit.prod_code');
 end if;
 end if; 
end;

declare
 temp_product_code VARCHAR2(8);
 temp_product_code_desc VARCHAR2(300);
begin
 
 IF :ctrl_unit.s_prod_code != 'M'
 then
 If :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' then 
 validate_product_scan_coexist(:ctrl_unit.s_prod_code,temp_product_code,temp_product_code_desc);
 Else
 validate_product_scan_coexist(upper(:ctrl_unit.s_prod_code),temp_product_code,temp_product_code_desc);
 End If;

 if not form_success 
 then
 :ctrl_unit.s_prod_code := '';
 :ctrl_unit.prod_code := '';
 :ctrl_unit.s_prod_code_desc := '';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if; 
 :ctrl_unit.prod_code := temp_product_code;
 :ctrl_unit.s_prod_code_desc := temp_product_code_desc;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 prd_cnt NUMBER;
 v_local_time DATE;

begin
 
 v_local_time := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := FALSE;


 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO prd_cnt
 FROM components c, valid_products v
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND TRUNC(coll_date) = TRUNC(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND c.reject_reason_code IS NULL
 AND v.product_code = SUBSTR(:ctrl_unit.prod_code,1,5)
 AND NVL(v.pathogen_reduction_flag,'N') != 'Y'
 AND NVL(v.dummy_product_flag, 'N') != 'Y'
 AND v.product_type IN
 (
 SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 2)) 
 FROM master_codes mc
 WHERE mc.code_type = 'PARDT'
 AND TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 1)) = :ctrl_unit.s_prod_cat
 AND v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_local_time+1)
 )
 AND v.product_code = SUBSTR(c.product_code,1,5)
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_local_time + 1)
 AND v.product_code NOT IN 
 ( SELECT SUBSTR(product_code, 1, 5)
 FROM pathogen_final_products
 WHERE unit_id= :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 );


 IF prd_cnt = 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO prd_cnt
 FROM components c, valid_products v, pathogen_reduction_details prd
 WHERE c.unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND c.unit_id = prd.unit_id
 AND TRUNC(c.coll_date) = TRUNC(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND c.reject_reason_code IS NOT NULL
 AND v.product_code = SUBSTR(:ctrl_unit.prod_code,1,5)
 AND NVL(v.pathogen_reduction_flag,'N') != 'Y'
 AND NVL(v.dummy_product_flag, 'N') != 'Y'
 AND v.product_type IN
 (
 SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 2)) 
 FROM master_codes mc
 WHERE mc.code_type = 'PARDT'
 AND TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 1)) = :ctrl_unit.s_prod_cat
 AND v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_local_time+1)
 )
 AND v.product_code = SUBSTR(c.product_code,1,5)
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND v_local_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_local_time + 1);
 
 
 IF prd_cnt = 0 THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 IF :FORMS_VAR.PRUP_ACCESS = 'N' THEN
 show_error('0478');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := TRUE;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;



 -- check for inter;
 GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode := :ctrl_unit.prod_code;
 GLOBALVAR.l_prodType := get_prod_type;
 
 IF inter_found THEN
 show_error('0243');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 -------------

 suit_check;
 
 
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE

 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 nCnt NUMBER;
 
 CURSOR vprc_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE suspension_type = :pr_details.suspension_type
 --AND equip_type = NVL(:pr_details.equip_type, equip_type)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 
BEGIN
 -- Required only for Platelets. Not required for Plasma.
 IF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;

 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 IF GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE suspension_type = :pr_details.suspension_type
 AND equip_type = NVL(:pr_details.equip_type, equip_type)
 AND volume_type_set = NVL(:pr_details.vol_type_set, volume_type_set)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1); 
 
 IF nCnt = 0 THEN
 show_error('0423');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 IF :pr_details.suspension_type IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := vprc_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE vprc_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 -- populate from validation table if equip is not there in components_cgmp table.
 IF :pr_details.equip_type IS NULL THEN
 :pr_details.equip_type := :pr_details.s_valid_equip_type; 
 ELSE
 IF :pr_details.equip_type <> :pr_details.s_valid_equip_type THEN
 show_error('0468');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 show_error('0423'); --message('Invalid Suspension Type');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; 


END;

DECLARE
 CURSOR cmp_cur IS
 SELECT component_count, component_weight,anticoagulant_volume
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND SUBSTR(product_code, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(:ctrl_unit.prod_code, 1, 5);
 
 CURSOR products_cur IS
 SELECT NVL(specific_gravity,1)
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = SUBSTR(:ctrl_unit.prod_code, 1, 5)
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1);
 
 cmp_cnt NUMBER;
 nPLTCount NUMBER;
 nProdWt NUMBER;
 nAntiCogVol NUMBER;
 nGravity NUMBER;

BEGIN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 
 OPEN cmp_cur;
 FETCH cmp_cur INTO nPLTCount, nProdWt, nAntiCogVol; --:pr_details.init_plt_count, :pr_details.initial_prod_weight, :pr_details.anticoagulant_volume;
 CLOSE cmp_cur;
 
 -- Assign Platelet count only for PLATELET Product type. 
 IF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 :pr_details.init_plt_count := nPLTCount;

Item.Name: INITIAL_PROD_WEIGHT
Item.Hint: Enter product weight between 1 and 999.99 gms

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nGravity NUMBER;
 nVolume NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_weight IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 if( LTRIM(:pr_details.initial_prod_weight,'0123456789.') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 show_error('0250');
 check_package_failure;
 else 
 if :pr_details.initial_prod_weight > 999.99 or :pr_details.initial_prod_weight < 1 then
 show_error('0250');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; 
 
 if :ctrl_unit.prod_code is not null then
 nGravity := prod_gravity(:ctrl_unit.prod_code); -- throws error if Gravity is not defined .
 
 nVolume := ROUND((:pr_details.initial_prod_weight / NVL(nGravity, 1)),2);
 
 -- V23 --update only when volume is different as it is changing the query status to CHANGED. 
 IF nVolume <> :pr_details.initial_prod_vol THEN
 :PR_DETAILS.INITIAL_PROD_VOL := nVolume;
 END IF;
 
 item_change('pr_details.initial_prod_vol', 'D'); 
 end if;
 END IF; 


EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 
END;

Item.Name: INITIAL_PROD_VOL
Item.Hint: Enter volume of the product.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nGravity NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_weight IS NULL AND :pr_details.initial_prod_vol IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0428');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_vol IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_vol <= 0 THEN
 show_error('0425');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_weight IS NULL AND :ctrl_unit.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 nGravity := prod_gravity(:ctrl_unit.prod_code); -- throws error if Gravity is not defined for the product.
 
 -- V23 --update only if existing value is different.To avoid RECORD_STATUS to get changed to CHANGED in QUERY mode (when nothing was changed)
 IF nGravity <> :pr_details.initial_prod_weight THEN 
 :pr_details.initial_prod_weight := :pr_details.initial_prod_vol * NVL(nGravity, 1);
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 


END;

Item.Name: VOL_TYPE_SET
Item.Hint: Enter Volume Type Set or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE

 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 
 plt_cnt_fail BOOLEAN;
 prod_vol_fail BOOLEAN;
 
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 
 plas_config_cnt NUMBER;
 plt_config_cnt NUMBER;
 
 CURSOR volType_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, master_codes mc
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = mc.code
 AND mc.code_type= 'VTYST'
 AND vprc.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND mc.code = :pr_details.vol_type_set 
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN mc.eff_date AND NVL(mc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1)
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1)
 and vprc.volume_type_set in (select volume_type_set from valid_lots where 
 chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and
 volume_type_set is not null and
 :forms_var.chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN mc.eff_date AND 
 NVL(mc.term_date, :forms_var.chp_SYSDATE+1)) ; 
 
BEGIN
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);


 -- Check if valid value is entered.
 OPEN volType_cur;
 FETCH volType_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := volType_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE volType_cur;
 
 IF NOT l_recFound THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0421'); -- Invalid Volume Type Set.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 
 IF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 
 SELECT count(1) INTO plt_config_Cnt
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE volume_type_set = :pr_details.vol_type_set
 AND suspension_type = :pr_details.suspension_type
 AND equip_type = :pr_details.equip_type
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1); 

 IF plt_config_Cnt = 0 THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0441'); -- Type set configuration is not defined.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF plt_config_Cnt > 1 THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0442'); -- Multiple type set configurations found.
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 plt_cnt_fail := plt_typeset_fail('PLT_CNT'); -- returns true if failed OR false.
 prod_vol_fail := plt_typeset_fail('PROD_VOL');
 
 IF plt_cnt_fail AND prod_vol_fail THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0424', ' - Platelet Count and Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF plt_cnt_fail THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0424', ' - Platelet Count'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSIF prod_vol_fail THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0424', ' - Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 ELSIF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO plas_config_cnt
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE volume_type_set = :pr_details.vol_type_set
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 
 IF plas_config_cnt = 0 THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0441'); -- Type set configuration is not defined.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF plas_config_cnt > 1 THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0442'); -- Multiple type set configurations found.
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;

 prod_vol_fail := plas_typeset_fail('PROD_VOL'); 
 
 IF prod_vol_fail THEN
 disable_suit_buttons;
 show_error('0424', ' - Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 l_status_reason VARCHAR2(200);
 l_status_flag VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 
 check_validation_failure;
 
 -- This validation is added by Edwin to reinforce the validity of the product code.
 -- IM 740 (in LT2015R2SP3 version)
 If :pr_details.suit_prod_code is not null then 
 If length(:pr_details.suit_prod_code)!=8 then 
 go_item('pr_details.suit_prod_code');
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 End If; 
 
 Check_Suitability(l_status_flag, l_status_reason);
 
 

 IF l_status_flag = 'Y' THEN
 set_suit_status('SUITABLE');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_print_label', 'E');
 IF :pr_details.suit_prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_sterile_docking', 'E');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 set_suit_status('NOT SUITABLE');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_print_label', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_sterile_docking', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_reject','E');
 END IF;
 
 -- V23 -- Update only when status flag OR status reason is changed. Added to avoid
 -- RECORD_STATUS to get changed to 'CHANGED' when re-entering the screen without any changes.
 IF l_status_flag <> NVL(:pr_details.suit_status_code,'X') THEN
 :pr_details.suit_status_code := l_status_flag;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_status_reason <> NVL(:pr_details.suitability_status,'X') THEN
 :pr_details.suitability_status := l_status_reason;
 END IF;
 ---------

 
END;

 GLOBALVAR.rec_sterile_au.wafer_lot_no := :STERILE_DOCKING_CTRL.WAFER_LOT_NO;

 -----------

 OR NVL(GLOBALVAR.rec_sterile_bu.wafer_lot_no,'@#') <> NVL(GLOBALVAR.rec_sterile_au.wafer_lot_no, '@#')

 ELSE

 ------------

 END IF;
 
 END IF;
END;

declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_count1 number;
 temp_batch_ID VARCHAR2(14);
 l_cnt NUMBER;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 select count(*) into temp_count1 from arc_log_det
 where
 unit_id=:ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pi_unit.s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 if temp_count1 > 0 then
 show_error('0214');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 IF :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date is null THEN
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date is null
 then
 :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pi_unit.s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 /*
 declare
 CURSOR units_cur IS
 select bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 
 item_change('pr_details.bleed_start_time', 'E');
 item_change('pr_details.bleed_end_time', 'E');
 
 OPEN units_cur;
 FETCH units_cur INTO :pr_details.bleed_start_time, :pr_details.bleed_end_time;
 CLOSE units_cur;
 
 IF :pr_details.bleed_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 item_change('pr_details.bleed_start_time', 'D');

 END IF;
 
 end;
 */

 :ctrl_pi_unit.chapter_ID := :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 
 DECLARE
 l_cnt NUMBER;
 l_suitProdCode VARCHAR2(8) := NULL;
 BEGIN
 SELECT suit_prod_code INTO l_suitProdCode
 FROM pathogen_reduction_details
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id;
 
 :ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code := l_suitProdCode;
 intermediate_check(pl_suitProdCode => l_suitProdCode);
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 item_change('ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code','E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_pi_unit.s_suit_prod_code','E'); 
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pi_unit.s_suit_prod_code');

 END;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 l_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN

 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO l_cnt
 FROM valid_products v, pathogen_reduction_details prd, components c
 WHERE v.product_code = SUBSTR(prd.suit_prod_code, 1, 5)
 AND c.product_code = prd.suit_prod_code
 -- AND c.reject_reason_code IS NULL
 AND NVL(v.pathogen_reduction_flag ,'N') = 'Y'
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I' 
 AND prd.unit_ID = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND prd.suit_prod_code = :ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code
 AND prd.unit_id = c.unit_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN v.eff_date AND NVL(v.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 

 IF l_cnt = 0 THEN
 show_error('0439');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 
 intermediate_check(pl_suitProdCode => :ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := NVL(length(temp_start_code), 0);
 if :pi_details.s_equip_reference = 'M'
 then
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if NVL(length(:pi_details.s_equip_reference), 0) !=
 6 + NVL(length(temp_start_code), 0) + NVL(length(temp_end_code), 0)
 then
 :pi_details.s_equip_reference := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:pi_details.s_equip_reference, 1, temp_len),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:pi_details.s_equip_reference, 7 + temp_len,
 NVL(length(temp_start_code), 0)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx')
 then
 :pi_details.s_equip_reference := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :pi_details.illuminator_reference := 'EQ-'||substr(:pi_details.s_equip_reference,
 temp_len + 1, 6);
 
 begin
 
 select e.equip_type, v.code_desc, serial_number
 into :pi_details.s_equip_type, :pi_details.s_equip_type_desc, 
 :pi_details.s_serial_number
 from equip_master_codes v,
 equipment e
 where e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and e.equip_reference = :pi_details.illuminator_reference
 and e.equip_type = v.code
 and v.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and sysdate between v.eff_date
 and nvl(v.term_date, sysdate)
 and status = 'IN'
 and first_production_date <= trunc(sysdate);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 :pi_details.s_equip_reference := null;
 show_error ('3101'); --invalid equipment
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 go_item('pi_details.operator_id');
 
 /*
 begin
 
 select e.equip_type, v.code_desc, serial_number
 into :equip_type, :equip_type_desc, :serial_number
 from valid_attrib_equip a, equip_master_codes v,
 equipment e
 where e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and e.equip_reference = :equip_reference
 and e.equip_type = v.code
 and v.code_type = 'EQUIP'

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 l_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO l_cnt
 FROM valid_product_conv vp, valid_products v, valid_products p
 WHERE vp.source_product_code = v.product_code
 AND vp.target_product_code = p.product_code
 AND v.product_code = SUBSTR(:pi_details.suit_prod_code,1,5)
 AND vp.target_product_code = SUBSTR(:pi_details.cad_prod_code,1,5)
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I' --:GLOBAL.code_scheme
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN vp.eff_date AND NVL(vp.term_date, chp_SYSDATE+1)
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN v.eff_date AND NVL(v.term_date, chp_SYSDATE+1);
 


 IF l_cnt = 0 THEN
 show_error('0443');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 

 DECLARE
 l_final_prodCode VARCHAR2(10);
 l_temp_prodCode VARCHAR2(10); 
 BEGIN
 IF :pi_details.cad_prod_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(:pi_details.cad_prod_code) != 5 THEN
 l_temp_prodCode := :pi_details.cad_prod_code;
 calculate_intented_use( in_unit_id => :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, 
 temp_v_prod_code => SUBSTR(:pi_details.cad_prod_code,1,5), 
 out_prod_code => l_final_prodCode);
 
 IF :pi_details.cad_prod_code != l_final_prodCode THEN
 show_error('0443');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END; 
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 l_treatmentDate DATE;
 l_cadStartDate DATE;
BEGIN
 IF :pi_details.illuminator_reference IS NOT NULL THEN
 begin
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 select e.equip_type, e.serial_number, emc.code_desc 
 into :pi_details.s_equip_type, :pi_details.s_serial_number , :pi_details.s_equip_type_desc
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes emc
 where emc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and emc.code = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference = :pi_details.illuminator_reference 
 and e.first_production_date <= trunc(chp_sysdate)
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and chp_sysdate between emc.eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 exception 
 when others then
 :pi_details.s_equip_type := null;
 :pi_details.s_serial_number := null;
 :pi_details.s_equip_type_desc := null;
 end;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pi_details.treatment_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 l_treatmentDate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, :pi_details.treatment_start_time);
 :pi_details.s_treatment_date := l_treatmentDate;
 :pi_details.s_treatment_time := l_treatmentDate;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pi_details.cad_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 l_cadStartDate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, :pi_details.cad_start_time);
 :pi_details.s_cad_start_date := l_cadStartDate;
 :pi_details.s_cad_start_time := l_cadStartDate;
 END IF;

 IF :pi_details.treatment_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pi_details.s_total_treatment_time := TO_DATE(:pi_details.treatment_time, 'HH24:MI');
 END IF;
 
 
 -- Display notes
 :pi_details.s_inst_msg := :pi_details.illuminator_message;

 -- 
 SELECT DECODE(:pi_details.illumination_status, 1, 'Complete', 0, 'InComplete', NULL)
 INTO :pi_details.illumination_status_desc
 FROM dual; 
 
 :ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code := :pi_details.suit_prod_code;
 
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 lv_place_remove_weld_inter VARCHAR2(10) := NULL;
 
 FUNCTION place_remove_weld_inter RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 lv_place_remove_inter VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 IF globalvar.rec_bag_bu.seal_ok = 'Y' AND globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok = 'N' THEN

 lv_place_remove_inter := 'PLACE';

 ELSIF globalvar.rec_bag_bu.seal_ok = 'N' AND globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok = 'Y' THEN 
 
 lv_place_remove_inter := 'REMOVE';
 END IF;
 
 RETURN lv_place_remove_inter;
 END place_remove_weld_inter;
 
 PROCEDURE treatment_time_check IS
 ld_treatment_dt DATE;
 nhr NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF :pi_details.s_treatment_date IS NOT NULL
 AND :pi_details.s_treatment_time IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 ld_treatment_dt := to_date(to_char(:pi_details.s_treatment_date, 'MM-DD-RR')
 || ' '
 || to_char(:pi_details.s_treatment_time, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM_DD-RR HH24:MI');

 nhr := 24 * ( ld_treatment_dt - :pi_details.bleed_end_time );
 IF nhr > to_number(globalvar.pi_ill_start) THEN
 go_item('pi_details.s_treatment_time');
 show_error('0476');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END treatment_time_check;
 
 PROCEDURE POPULATE_DB_ITEMS IS
 chp_treatmentstarttime DATE;
 chp_cadstarttime DATE;
 l_err_code VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 IF :pi_details.s_treatment_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_treatmentstarttime := to_date(to_char(:pi_details.s_treatment_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY')
 || ' '
 || to_char(:pi_details.s_treatment_time, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');

 :pi_details.treatment_start_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, chp_treatmentstarttime);
 END IF;

 IF :pi_details.s_total_treatment_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pi_details.treatment_time := to_char(:pi_details.s_total_treatment_time, 'HH24:MI');
 END IF;

 IF :pi_details.s_cad_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_cadstarttime := to_date(to_char(:pi_details.s_cad_start_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY')
 || ' '
 || to_char(:pi_details.s_cad_start_time, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');

 :pi_details.cad_start_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, chp_cadstarttime);
 END IF;

 IF
 :pi_details.s_inst_msg IS NOT NULL
 AND nvl(:pi_details.illuminator_message, '@#') <> :pi_details.s_inst_msg
 THEN
 :pi_details.illuminator_message := :pi_details.s_inst_msg;
 insert_notes(pl_prod_code => :pi_details.suit_prod_code, pl_msg => :pi_details.s_inst_msg, pl_err_code => l_err_code);

 IF l_err_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_error(l_err_code);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END POPULATE_DB_ITEMS; 
 
 
 PROCEDURE save_button_process IS
 l_cnt NUMBER;
 l_catalognum VARCHAR2(10);
 lb_bag_removed BOOLEAN;
 BEGIN
 treatment_time_check;
 
 IF :pi_details.s_cad_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 go_item('pi_details.s_cad_start_time');
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 -- Populate db items. (Moved from pre-update to here)
 POPULATE_DB_ITEMS;
 ----------------
 IF globalvar.bag_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_illumination
 AND suit_prod_code = :pi_details.suit_prod_code;

 lv_place_remove_weld_inter := place_remove_weld_inter;
 
 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'PLACE' THEN
 place_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => :pi_details.suit_prod_code);
 ELSIF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'REMOVE' THEN
 remove_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => :pi_details.suit_prod_code);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 place_weld_inter(p_suitprodcode => :pi_details.suit_prod_code, 
 p_weldprodcode => :pi_details.suit_prod_code, 
 p_proccode => globalvar.c_illumination);
 END IF;
 
 IF :pi_details.cad_prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF seal_check_passed(unit_id_in => :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, process_code_in => globalvar.c_illumination, suit_prod_code_in => :pi_details.suit_prod_code) 
 THEN
 SELECT
 COUNT(1)
 INTO l_cnt
 FROM
 components
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date
 AND product_code = :pi_details.cad_prod_code;

 IF l_cnt = 0 THEN 
 -- IM 275
 IF :pi_details.s_cad_start_time IS NULL THEN
 go_item('pi_details.s_cad_start_time');
 show_error('0080', '- CAD Start time');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 l_catalognum := get_catalognum(:pi_details.set_id_lot_no, :pi_details.vol_type_set); -- V07

 insert_comp(pl_unitid => :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, 
 pl_colldate => :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date, 
 pl_prodcode => :pi_details.cad_prod_code, 
 pl_catalog_no => l_catalognum, -- V07
 pl_oldprodcode => :pi_details.suit_prod_code); 
 
 -- IM 256
 IF globalvar.bu_prodcode IS NOT NULL
 AND globalvar.bu_prodcode <> :pi_details.cad_prod_code
 THEN -- UPDATE INTER PRODUCT scenario.
 delete_comp(pl_prodcode => globalvar.bu_prodcode);
 -- no need to udpate sterile (as it is based on SUIT PROD CODE)
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END save_button_process;

 PROCEDURE update_button_process IS
 BEGIN
 IF :PI_DETAILS.S_SERIAL_NUMBER IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', '- Serial No.');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :PI_DETAILS.S_TREATMENT_DATE IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', '- Treatment Date');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :PI_DETAILS.ILLUMINATION_STATUS IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', ' - Treatment Time');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pi_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 IF :PI_DETAILS.S_CAD_START_DATE IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', ' - Treatment Time');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 
 IF :PI_DETAILS.S_CAD_START_TIME IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', ' - Treatment Time');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 

 treatment_time_check;
 
 POPULATE_DB_ITEMS;
 
 -- 3) Update sterile docking table is psoralen bag removal window is updated.
 IF globalvar.bag_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_illumination
 AND suit_prod_code = :pi_details.suit_prod_code;

 lv_place_remove_weld_inter := place_remove_weld_inter;
 
 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'PLACE' THEN
 place_weld_on_final_product(:ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, :pi_details.suit_prod_code, GLOBALVAR.C_ILLUMINATION); 
 ELSIF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'REMOVE' THEN
 remove_weld_on_final_product(:ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, :pi_details.suit_prod_code, GLOBALVAR.C_ILLUMINATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END update_button_process;

BEGIN 

 -- IM 271
 check_validation_failure;
 -- 

 IF globalvar.lb_update_mode THEN
 update_button_process;
 ELSE
 save_button_process;
 END IF;
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 commit_form;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 init_view('PI_PROCESS');
END;

 );

 End If;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 l_cadEndDate := to_date(to_char(:pf_transfer.s_cad_end_date, 'MM-DD-RR') || ' ' 
 || to_char(:pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');

 :pf_transfer.cad_end_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, l_cadEndDate); 
 
 l_cadStartDate := to_date(to_char(:pf_transfer.s_cad_start_date, 'MM-DD-RR') || ' ' 
 || to_char(:pf_transfer.s_cad_start_time, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 IF l_cadEndDate > chp_sysdate THEN
 show_error('0451');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF l_cadEndDate < l_cadStartDate THEN
 show_error('0452');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 
 cad_time_check(l_cadStartDate, l_cadEndDate, l_EARLY_LATE);

 IF l_early_late = 'EARLY' THEN
 :forms_var.cad_status := 'EARLY'; -- used for navigation.
 :pf_transfer.s_cad_status := 'Too early to transfer the product, place back on CAD rotator'; 
 set_item_property( 'pf_transfer.s_cad_status', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'GREEN_REC' );
 -- Reject (disable reject items)
 reject_items(p_enable => 'N'); 
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save');
 ELSIF l_early_late = 'LATE' THEN
 :forms_var.cad_status := 'LATE'; -- used for navigation.
 :pf_transfer.s_cad_status := 'Exceeded CAD Time';
 set_item_property( 'pf_transfer.s_cad_status', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'RED_REC');
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer.pb_reject','E');
 -- Reject (disable reject items)
 reject_items(p_enable => 'N'); 
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save');
 ELSE
 :forms_var.cad_status := 'READY'; -- used for navigation. 
 :pf_transfer.s_cad_status := 'Ready';
 set_item_property( 'pf_transfer.s_cad_status', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'DEFAULT_REC');
 -- Reject (enable reject items)
 reject_items(p_enable => 'Y');
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.s_prd_num_of_bags');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 


END;

declare
 temp_count number;

 l_cnt NUMBER;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 select count(*) into temp_count1 from arc_log_det
 where
 unit_id=:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pf_unit.s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 if temp_count1 > 0 then
 show_error('0214');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 IF :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date is null THEN
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date is null
 then
 :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pf_unit.s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 

 
 DECLARE
 l_cnt NUMBER;
 l_suitProdCode VARCHAR2(8) := NULL;
 l_prod_cat VARCHAR2(10);
 CURSOR prod_cat_cur IS
 SELECT prod_category
 FROM pathogen_reduction_details
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id;
 BEGIN
 OPEN prod_cat_cur;
 FETCH prod_cat_cur INTO l_prod_cat;
 CLOSE prod_cat_cur;
 
 
 SELECT suit_prod_code INTO l_suitProdCode
 FROM pathogen_reduction_details
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id;

 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code','D');
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.cad_prod_code','D'); 
 :ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code := l_suitProdCode;
 final_check(pl_suitProdCode => l_suitProdCode);
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 IF l_prod_cat = 'PLT' THEN
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.s_suit_prod_code','D');
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code','D'); 
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.s_cad_prod_code','E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.cad_prod_code','E'); 
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pf_unit.s_cad_prod_code'); 
 ELSIF l_prod_cat = 'PLAS' THEN
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.s_suit_prod_code','E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code','E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.s_cad_prod_code','D'); 
 item_change('ctrl_pf_unit.cad_prod_code','D'); 
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pf_unit.s_suit_prod_code');
 END IF;
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 RAISE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 final_check(pl_suitProdCode => l_suitProdCode);
 END; 

 
end;

 lv_place_remove_inter VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 IF globalvar.rec_bag_bu.seal_ok = 'Y' AND globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok = 'N' THEN

 lv_place_remove_inter := 'PLACE';

 ELSIF globalvar.rec_bag_bu.seal_ok = 'N' AND globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok = 'Y' THEN 
 
 lv_place_remove_inter := 'REMOVE';
 END IF;
 
 RETURN lv_place_remove_inter;
 END place_remove_weld_inter;

 lb_product_complete BOOLEAN := TRUE; -- Default to TRUE;
 lb_bag_removed BOOLEAN;
 l_api_cnt NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 l_serial_number VARCHAR2(30);

 PROCEDURE insert_comp_process IS
 l_catalognum VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 IF :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT IS NOT NULL THEN
 check_count_pimgr(p_unit_id => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, p_coll_date => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date, p_chapter_id => :global.chapter_id,
 p_product_code => :pf_products.prod_code, p_count => :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT,
 p_prod_category => :pf_transfer.prod_category,
 p_suit_prod_code => :pf_transfer.SUIT_PROD_CODE);
 
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_products.prod_vol IS NOT NULL THEN
 check_volume_pimgr(p_unit_id => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, p_coll_date => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date, p_chapter_id => :global.chapter_id,
 p_product_code => :pf_products.prod_code, p_volume => :pf_products.prod_vol,
 p_prod_category => :pf_transfer.prod_category,
 p_suit_prod_code => :pf_transfer.suit_prod_code);
 
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 l_catalognum := get_catalognum(:pf_transfer.set_id_lot_no, :pf_transfer.vol_type_set); -- V07
 insert_comp(pl_unitid => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, pl_colldate => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date, pl_prodcode => :pf_products.prod_code,
 pl_catalog_no => l_catalognum, pl_oldprodcode => :pf_transfer.cad_prod_code,
 pl_weight => :pf_products.prod_weight);
 
 -- IM 256
 IF :pf_products.old_prod_code IS NOT NULL 
 AND :pf_products.old_prod_code <> :pf_products.prod_code -- MLT 6402 (Comparing prod. code with old prod. code - delete only if not equal.)
 THEN -- UPDATE INTER PRODUCT scenario.
 delete_comp(pl_prodcode => :pf_products.old_prod_code);
 -- no need to update sterile as it is based on SUIT prod code.
 END IF;
 
 ELSIF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 l_catalognum := get_catalognum(:pi_details.set_id_lot_no, :pi_details.vol_type_set); -- V07
 insert_comp(pl_unitid => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, pl_colldate => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date, pl_prodcode => :pf_products.prod_code,
 pl_catalog_no => l_catalognum, pl_oldprodcode => :pf_transfer.suit_prod_code,
 pl_weight => :pf_products.prod_weight);
 
 IF :pf_products.old_prod_code IS NOT NULL -- UPDATE INTER PRODUCT scenario.
 AND :pf_products.old_prod_code <> :pf_products.prod_code THEN-- MLT 6402 (Comparing prod. code with old prod. code - delete only if not equal.)
 delete_comp(pl_prodcode => :pf_products.old_prod_code);
 -- no need to update sterile as it is based on SUIT prod code.
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 UPDATE components
 SET
 component_count = :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT * 10,
 anticoagulant_volume = :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date)
 AND product_code = :pf_products.prod_code;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 place_weld_inter(p_suitprodcode => :ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code, p_weldprodcode => :pf_products.prod_code, p_proccode => globalvar.
 c_cad);
 
 END insert_comp_process;
 
 PROCEDURE UPDATE_COMP_PLTCNT_ACOAGVOL IS
 BEGIN
 IF :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT IS NOT NULL THEN
 check_count_pimgr(p_unit_id => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, p_coll_date => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date, p_chapter_id => :global.chapter_id,
 p_product_code => :pf_products.prod_code, p_count => :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT,
 p_prod_category => :pf_transfer.prod_category,
 p_suit_prod_code => :pf_transfer.SUIT_PROD_CODE);
 
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 UPDATE components
 SET
 component_count = :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT * 10,
 anticoagulant_volume = :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

 FUNCTION pf_fields_entered RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 BEGIN
 IF
 :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT'
 AND :pf_products.prod_code IS NOT NULL
 AND :pf_products.prod_weight IS NOT NULL
 AND :pf_products.verify_prod_code IS NOT NULL
 AND :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 RETURN true;
 ELSIF
 :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLAS'
 AND :pf_products.prod_code IS NOT NULL
 AND :pf_products.prod_weight IS NOT NULL
 AND :pf_products.verify_prod_code IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 RETURN true;
 ELSE
 RETURN false;
 END IF;
 END pf_fields_entered; 
 BEGIN
 
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 IF :pf_transfer.s_cad_end_date IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_date');
 show_error('0080','CAD End Date');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time'); 
 show_error('0080','CAD End Time');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_transfer.final_prd_num_of_bags IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF :pf_products.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :pf_products.prod_weight IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_products.prod_weight');
 show_error('0080','Product Weight');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_products.verify_prod_code IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_products.s_verify_prod_Code');
 show_error('0080','Verify Product Code');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 END;
 
 -- plasma category does not have CAD BAG removal process.
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLAS' OR seal_check_passed(unit_id_in => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, process_code_in => globalvar.c_CAD, suit_prod_code_in => :ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code) THEN
 BEGIN 
 go_block('pf_products');
 first_record;
 LOOP
 IF :pf_products.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 lb_product_rec_found := TRUE;
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO l_cnt
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date
 AND product_code = :pf_products.prod_code;
 
 IF l_cnt = 0 THEN 
 INSERT_COMP_PROCESS; 
 ELSE-- l_cnt <> 0 (Component was already created);
 -- we allow them to enter platelet count after component was created.
 UPDATE_COMP_PLTCNT_ACOAGVOL; 
 END IF; 
 
 IF NOT pf_fields_entered THEN
 lb_product_complete := FALSE; -- Use this to update API_PATHOTGEN_REDUCTION table complete status.
 -- Do not update the complete_status in api table if one of the record is not completly entered.
 END IF; 
 END IF; -- IF prod_code NOT NULL
 
 
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 END;
 END IF; 
 END IF;

 IF globalvar.bag_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.C_CAD
 AND suit_prod_code = :ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code;

 lv_place_remove_weld_inter := place_remove_weld_inter;
 
 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'PLACE' THEN
 place_weld_on_final_product(:CTRL_PF_UNIT.unit_id, :CTRL_PF_UNIT.suit_prod_code, GLOBALVAR.C_CAD); 
 ELSIF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'REMOVE' THEN
 remove_weld_on_final_product(:CTRL_PF_UNIT.unit_id, :CTRL_PF_UNIT.suit_prod_code, GLOBALVAR.C_CAD);
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
 
 IF lb_product_rec_found AND lb_product_complete THEN
 -- Check if record found in api_pathogen_reduction table.
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO l_api_cnt 
 FROM api_pathogen_reduction
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id and product_code=:ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code;
 
 IF l_api_cnt = 0 THEN -- manual illuminator insert (no record in api table, details are in pathogen_reduction_details table)
 IF :pf_transfer.illuminator_reference IS NOT NULL THEN
 begin
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 select e.serial_number
 into l_serial_number
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes emc
 where emc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and emc.code = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference = :pf_transfer.illuminator_reference 
 and e.first_production_date <= trunc(chp_sysdate)
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and chp_sysdate between emc.eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate+1)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception 
 when others then
 l_serial_number := NULL;
 end;
 END IF; 
 
 INSERT INTO api_pathogen_reduction_arch(file_id, instrument_code, unit_id, unit_suffix, product_code, treatment_start_time,
 total_treatment_time, dosage_measured, status, target_dose, operator_id, 
 chamber_number, agitation_time, inst_message_code, software_version, site_code, lot_number, 
 set_code, check_sum, record_status,
 insert_date, insert_user, program_id, audit_key, chapter_id)
 VALUES('MANUAL', l_serial_number, :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, NULL, :pf_transfer.suit_prod_code, :pf_transfer.treatment_start_time,
 :pf_transfer.treatment_time, NULL, :pf_transfer.illumination_status, NULL, :pf_transfer.operator_id,
 NULL, NULL, :pf_transfer.illuminator_message, NULL, 'MANUAL', :pf_transfer.set_id_lot_no, 
 'MANUAL', NULL, 'C',
 SYSDATE, :BANNER.user_id, :BANNER.prog_name, :pf_transfer.audit_key, :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 );
 
 ELSE -- record found in api table 
 update_api_pathogen_reduction(:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id,:ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code);
 END IF; --record found in api table.
 END IF; -- complete flag condition 
 END save_button_process;

 check_count_pimgr( p_unit_id => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id,

 check_package_failure;
 
 UPDATE components

 BEGIN
 check_volume_pimgr( p_unit_id => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id,

 p_chapter_id => :global.chapter_id,

 check_package_failure;
 
 UPDATE components

 BEGIN
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 IF :pf_transfer.s_cad_end_date IS NULL THEN

 show_error('0080','CAD End Date');

 ELSIF :pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time IS NULL THEN

 check_package_failure;

 IF :pf_transfer.final_prd_num_of_bags IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.final_prd_num_of_bags');
 show_error('0080','No. Of Bags');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 -- required fields check in pf products. 
 BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF :pf_products.prod_weight IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_products.prod_weight');
 show_error('0080','Product Weight for ' || :pf_products.prod_code);
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT' AND :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT');
 show_error('0080','Platelet Count for ' || :pf_products.prod_code);
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 END; 

 -- 3) Update sterile docking table is psoralen bag removal window is updated.
 IF GLOBALVAR.bag_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET weld_ok = GLOBALVAR.rec_bag_au.seal_ok
 WHERE unit_id = :CTRL_PF_UNIT.UNIT_ID
 AND proc_code = GLOBALVAR.C_CAD
 AND suit_prod_code = :CTRL_PF_UNIT.suit_prod_code;
 
 lv_place_remove_weld_inter := place_remove_weld_inter;
 
 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'PLACE' THEN
 place_weld_on_final_product(:CTRL_PF_UNIT.unit_id, :CTRL_PF_UNIT.suit_prod_code, GLOBALVAR.C_CAD); 
 ELSIF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'REMOVE' THEN
 remove_weld_on_final_product(:CTRL_PF_UNIT.unit_id, :CTRL_PF_UNIT.suit_prod_code, GLOBALVAR.C_CAD);
 END IF; 
 END IF; 

 -- check if weight or anticoagulant has to be updated.
 DECLARE
 ln_comp_cnt NUMBER; 
 ln_anticoag_vol NUMBER;
 ln_comp_weight NUMBER;
 BEGIN 
 go_block('pf_products');
 first_record;
 LOOP
 IF :pf_products.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT component_count, anticoagulant_volume, component_weight
 INTO ln_comp_cnt, ln_anticoag_vol, ln_comp_weight
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date)
 AND product_code = :pf_products.prod_code; 
 
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT' AND :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF ln_comp_cnt <> :PF_PRODUCTS.FINAL_PLT_COUNT THEN 
 check_inter_update_comp_cnt;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF ln_anticoag_vol <> :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume THEN
 update_comp_anticoag_vol;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- if weight is not matching, check for interdictions based on volume (calculated field)
 -- update weight.
 IF :pf_products.prod_weight IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF ln_comp_weight <> :pf_products.prod_weight THEN
 check_inter_update_comp_weight;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 END IF; -- IF prod_code NOT NULL
 
 
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 END;
 END update_button_process; 
BEGIN
 -- IM 271
 check_validation_failure;
 --
 

 IF GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode THEN
 update_button_process;
 ELSE
 save_button_process;
 END IF;
 
 :system.message_level :='10';
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 
 if form_failure then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :system.message_level :='10';
 CLEAR_MESSAGE;
 show_error('8010');
 :system.message_level :='0';
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 INIT_VIEW('PF_TRANSFER');
EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 RAISE;

 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 Handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER; 
 l_recFound BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
CURSOR prod_cur IS 
 SELECT 1
 FROM valid_product_conv vp, valid_products v, valid_products p
 WHERE vp.source_product_code = v.product_code
 AND vp.target_product_code = p.product_code
 AND vp.source_product_code = DECODE(:pf_transfer.prod_category, 
 'PLAS', SUBSTR(:pf_transfer.suit_prod_code, 1, 5),
 SUBSTR(:pf_transfer.cad_prod_code,1,5)
 )
 AND vp.target_product_code = SUBSTR(:pf_products.prod_code,1,5) 
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vp.eff_date AND NVL(vp.term_date, chp_sysdate +1)
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN v.eff_date AND NVL(v.term_date, chp_sysdate +1);
 
BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 OPEN prod_cur;
 FETCH prod_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := prod_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE prod_cur;
 
 IF NOT l_recFound THEN
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF NOT is_Gravity_Defined(:pf_products.prod_code) THEN
 show_error('0447');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 DECLARE
 l_final_prodCode VARCHAR2(10); 
 BEGIN
 IF LENGTH(:pf_products.prod_code) != 5 THEN
 calculate_intented_use( in_unit_id => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, 
 temp_v_prod_code => SUBSTR(:pf_products.prod_code,1,5), 
 out_prod_code => l_final_prodCode);
 IF :pf_products.prod_code <> l_final_prodCode THEN
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 END; 
 
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 CURSOR products_cur IS
 SELECT NVL(specific_gravity,1)
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = SUBSTR(:pf_products.prod_code, 1, 5)
 AND chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate +1);
 nGravity NUMBER; 
BEGIN
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 OPEN products_cur;
 FETCH products_cur INTO nGravity;
 CLOSE products_cur;
 
 
 :pf_products.prod_vol := ROUND((:pf_products.prod_weight)/NVL(nGravity,1), 2);
 
 IF :pf_products.prod_vol IS NOT NULL AND :pf_transfer.initial_prod_vol IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :pf_products.prod_vol > :pf_transfer.initial_prod_vol THEN
 show_error('0464');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume IS NULL THEN
 :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume := :pf_transfer.anticoagulant_volume;
 END IF;

 NEXT_ITEM;

END;

IF :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume IS NOT NULL AND
 :pf_transfer.anticoagulant_volume IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume > :pf_transfer.anticoagulant_volume THEN
 show_error('0467');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_products.anticoagulant_volume <= 0 THEN

DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;

-- message('test'); 
 synchronize;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 


--- message('test'); 
 synchronize;

 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 
 
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 
 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

Item.Name: VOL_TYPE_SET
Item.Hint: Enter Volume Type Set or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE

 CURSOR volType_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'VTYST'
 AND code = :pr_details.vol_type_set
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1); 
 
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 
 plt_cnt_fail BOOLEAN;
 prod_vol_fail BOOLEAN;

BEGIN
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 -- Check if valid value is entered.
 OPEN volType_cur;
 FETCH volType_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := volType_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE volType_cur;
 
 IF NOT l_recFound THEN
 show_error('0421'); -- Invalid Volume Type Set.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 plt_cnt_fail := plt_typeset_fail('PLT_CNT'); -- returns true if failed OR false.
 prod_vol_fail := plt_typeset_fail('PROD_VOL');
 
 IF plt_cnt_fail AND prod_vol_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Platelet Count and Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF plt_cnt_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Platelet Count'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSIF prod_vol_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_SUITABILITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Check_Suitability (p_status_flag OUT VARCHAR2, p_status OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 l_fail_msg VARCHAR2(100) := 'Product is not suitable for Pathogen Inactivation Process.';
 l_pass_msg VARCHAR2(100) := 'Product is suitable for Pathogen Inactivation Process.';
 l_rbc_msg VARCHAR2(100) := 'RBC Content check failed.';
 l_Aggr_msg VARCHAR2(100) := 'Unacceptable Platelet Aggregates.';
 l_bleed_msg VARCHAR2(100) := 'Product is too old (processed after @#$ hrs).';
 l_pltCnt_msg VARCHAR2(30) := 'Platelet Count';
 l_prdVol_msg VARCHAR2(30) := 'Product Volume';
 l_plasma_msg VARCHAR2(100) := 'Product has freeze time';
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000) := NULL;

 FUNCTION frozen_plasma_present RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR cgmp_cur IS 
 SELECT 1
 FROM component_cgmp
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_unit.prod_code
 AND parm_code = 'FRZ'
 AND process_dats IS NOT NULL;
 
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN; 
 BEGIN
 OPEN cgmp_cur;
 FETCH cgmp_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := cgmp_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE cgmp_cur;
 
 RETURN l_recFound;
 END frozen_plasma_present;
 
 FUNCTION rbc_content_status_chk RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_status BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 BEGIN
 IF NVL(:pr_details.rbc_content_status,'N') = 'N' THEN
 l_status := FALSE;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_status;
 END rbc_content_status_chk;
 
 FUNCTION aggr_acc_chk RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_status BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 BEGIN
 IF NVL(:pr_details.aggr_acc, 'N') = 'N' THEN
 l_status := FALSE;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_status;
 END aggr_acc_chk;
 
 FUNCTION bleed_time_chk RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 nHr NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 l_status BOOLEAN := TRUE; 
 l_limit VARCHAR2(10);
 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 
 CURSOR parm_cur IS
 SELECT parameter_value 
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'PI_END_CHK'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 l_limit := NULL;
 
 OPEN parm_cur;
 FETCH parm_cur INTO l_limit;
 CLOSE parm_cur;
 
 l_bleed_msg := REPLACE(l_bleed_msg, '@#$', l_limit);
 
 IF l_limit IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0454', '- PI_END_CHK');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 
 
 -- nHr := 24 * (chp_sysdate - :pr_details.bleed_end_time); -- IM 584
 nHr := 24 * (:pr_details.process_date_time - :pr_details.bleed_end_time);
 
 IF nHr < 0 THEN
 l_status := FALSE;
 ELSIF nHr > TO_NUMBER(l_limit) THEN
 l_status := FALSE;
 ELSE
 l_status := TRUE;
 END IF;
 /*
 -- Returns days elasped in number and time in hh24:mi:ss format.
 SELECT to_number( to_char(to_date('1','J') + (chp_sysdate - :pr_details.bleed_end_time), 'J') - 1) ,
 to_char(to_date('00:00:00','HH24:MI:SS') + (chp_sysdate - :pr_details.bleed_end_time), 'HH24:MI:SS') 
 INTO ndays, vtime
 FROM dual;
 
 
 IF ndays = 0 THEN -- Less than 1 day (within 24 hrs)
 NULL;
 ELSIF ndays = 1 THEN -- Equal to 1 day (24 hrs) - check minutes also to confirm if it is equal to 24 hrs or greater.
 ddate := TO_DATE('07/22/1980 '|| vtime, 'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi:ss');
 
 nHH24 := to_number(to_char(ddate, 'HH24'));
 nMI :=to_number(to_char(ddate, 'MI')) ;
 -- nSS := to_number(to_char(ddate, 'SS'))nSS ;
 
 IF nHH24 <> 0 OR nMI <> 0 THEN -- greater than 24 hrs.
 l_status := FALSE;
 END IF; 
 ELSE -- 2 or more days.
 l_status := FALSE; 
 END IF;
 */
 RETURN l_status;
 END bleed_time_chk; 
 
 -- moved as a seperate routine. 
 FUNCTION plt_typeset_chk(param_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 l_status BOOLEAN := TRUE; 
 
 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT min_vol, max_vol, min_plt_count, max_plt_count, min_cad_time, max_cad_time, max_storage_days
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE volume_type_set = :pr_details.vol_type_set
 AND suspension_type = :pr_details.suspension_type
 AND equip_type = :pr_details.equip_type
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_SYSDATE+1);
 l_setValues vprc_cur%ROWTYPE; 

 BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.vol_type_set IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO l_setValues;
 CLOSE vprc_cur; 
 
 IF param_in = 'PROD_VOL' THEN
 IF (:pr_details.initial_prod_vol < l_setValues.min_vol OR :pr_details.initial_prod_vol > l_setValues.max_vol ) THEN
 l_status := FALSE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF param_in = 'PLT_CNT' THEN
 IF :pr_details.init_plt_count < l_setValues.min_plt_count OR :pr_details.init_plt_count > l_setValues.max_plt_count THEN
 l_status := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_status;
 END plt_typeset_chk;
 -------------
 
 PROCEDURE set_status(p_msg IN VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 IF l_error IS NULL THEN
 l_error := p_msg; 
 ELSE
 l_error := l_error || CHR(10) || p_msg;
 END IF;
 END set_status;

BEGIN
 
 IF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 /*
 --1) Platelet Count Check;
 platelet_cnt_chk;
 */
 --1) Platelet Count check
 /* -- moved to type set check;
 IF NOT plt_typeset_chk('PLT_CNT') THEN
 set_status(l_pltCnt_msg) ;
 END IF;
 */
 --2) RBC Content Status Check;
 IF NOT rbc_content_status_chk THEN
 set_status(l_rbc_msg);
 END IF;
 
 --3) Aggregates Acceptablity check;
 IF NOT aggr_acc_chk THEN
 set_status(l_Aggr_msg);
 END IF;
 
 --4) Bleed End time check for 24 hrs.
 IF NOT bleed_time_chk THEN
 set_status(l_bleed_msg);
 END IF;
 
 --5) Volume Check;
 /* -- moved to type set check.
 IF NOT plt_typeset_chk('PROD_VOL') THEN
 set_status(l_prdVol_msg);
 END IF;
 */
 ELSIF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 --1)Frozen Plasma check
 IF :ctrl_unit.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF frozen_plasma_present THEN
 set_status(l_plasma_msg);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 --2) RBC Content Status Check;
 IF NOT rbc_content_status_chk THEN
 set_status(l_rbc_msg);
 END IF;
 
 /*
 --3) Aggregates Acceptablity check;
 IF NOT aggr_acc_chk THEN
 set_status(l_Aggr_msg);
 END IF;
 */
 
 --4) Bleed End time check for 24 hrs.
 IF NOT bleed_time_chk THEN
 set_status(l_bleed_msg);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_error IS NULL THEN
 --p_status := l_pass_msg;
 p_status := NULL;
 p_status_flag := 'Y';
 ELSE
 --p_status := l_fail_msg || l_error;
 p_status := l_error;
 p_status_flag := 'N';
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
END;

PROCEDURE item_change (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2, p_color IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Y') IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 --set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id, INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 IF p_color = 'Y' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id, background_color,'r255g255b255');
 END IF;
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then
 set_item_property(it_id,UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 elsif p_mode = 'D' then
 set_item_property(it_id, UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property(it_id, INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property(it_id, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 IF p_color = 'Y' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id, background_color,'r192g192b192'); 
 END IF;
 --set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 --set_item_property(it_id, font_style, font_outline);
 --set_item_property(it_id, foreground_color,'r000g000b000'); 
 end if ;
 end if ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_NOTES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INSERT_NOTES(pl_prod_code IN VARCHAR2, pl_msg IN VARCHAR2, pl_err_code OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 CURSOR cmp_cur IS 
 SELECT note_id
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND product_code = pl_prod_code
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; 
 l_noteID NUMBER;
 l_noteSEQ NUMBER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 
 pl_err_code := NULL;
 
 OPEN cmp_cur;
 FETCH cmp_cur INTO l_noteID;
 l_recFound := cmp_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE cmp_cur;

 IF l_recFound THEN
 IF l_noteID IS NULL THEN
 SELECT notebook_seq.NEXTVAL
 INTO l_noteID
 FROM dual;
 
 UPDATE components
 SET note_id = l_noteID
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date
 AND product_code = pl_prod_code 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT MAX(note_seq) + 1 
 INTO l_noteSEQ
 FROM note_books
 WHERE note_id = l_noteID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 l_noteSEQ := 1;
 END;
 
 
 INSERT INTO note_books
 (note_id, note, audit_key, note_seq,notes_table, chapter_id, 
 program_id, insert_user, insert_date)
 VALUES (l_noteID, pl_msg, NULL, NVL(l_noteSEQ,1) ,'COMPONENTS', :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :banner.prog_name, lt_user_session.get_userid, SYSDATE);
 
 
 ELSE
 pl_err_code := '0459'; -- This component does not exist.
 END IF; 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAD_TIME_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CAD_TIME_CHECK(pl_cad_start_time IN DATE, pl_cad_end_time IN DATE, pl_EARLY_LATE OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 ndays NUMBER;
 vtime VARCHAR2(10);
 nHH24 NUMBER;
 nMI NUMBER;
 ddate DATE;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 nMINCADTIME NUMBER;
 nMAXCADTIME NUMBER;
 nTotalTime NUMBER;


 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT min_cad_time, max_cad_time
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND vprc.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_SYSDATE+1);
 
 --l_setValues vprc_cur%ROWTYPE; 
 

BEGIN

 -- Returns days elasped in number and time in hh24:mi:ss format.
 SELECT to_number( to_char(to_date('1','J') + (pl_cad_end_time - pl_cad_start_time), 'J') - 1) ,
 to_char(to_date('00:00:00','HH24:MI:SS') + (pl_cad_end_time - pl_cad_start_time), 'HH24:MI:SS') 
 INTO ndays, vtime
 FROM dual;

 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO nMINCADTime, nMAXCADTime;
 CLOSE vprc_cur; 
 
 ddate := TO_DATE('07/22/1980 '|| vtime, 'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi:ss');
 
 nHH24 := to_number(to_char(ddate, 'HH24'));
 nMI :=to_number(to_char(ddate, 'MI')) ;
 
 
 
 nTotalTime := (ndays*24) + nHH24 + (nMI/60);
 
 :pf_transfer.cad_total_time := LPAD(TO_CHAR( (ndays*24) + nHH24 ), 2, '0') || ':' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(nMI), 2, '0');
 
 IF nTotalTime < nMINCADTime THEN
 pl_EARLY_LATE := 'EARLY'; 
 ELSIF nTotalTime > nMAXCADTime THEN
 pl_EARLY_LATE := 'LATE';
 END IF; 
 
END CAD_TIME_CHECK;

PROCEDURE enable_disable_item(p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 IF p_mode = 'E' THEN
 IF UPPER(p_item_name) IN ('PR_DETAILS_CTRL.PB_REM_PSORALEN', 'PI_DETAILS.PB_REM_ILLUMINATION', 'PF_TRANSFER_CTRL.PB_REM_CAD') 
 AND GLOBALVAR.l_PI_SEAL_RQ = 'N' THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE 
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 END IF;
 ELSIF p_mode = 'D' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLT_TYPESET_FAIL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION plt_typeset_fail(param_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_failStatus BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 
 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT min_vol, max_vol, min_plt_count, max_plt_count, min_cad_time, max_cad_time, max_storage_days
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE volume_type_set = :pr_details.vol_type_set
 AND suspension_type = :pr_details.suspension_type
 AND equip_type = :pr_details.equip_type
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);

 l_setValues vprc_cur%ROWTYPE; 
BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.vol_type_set IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);

 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO l_setValues;
 CLOSE vprc_cur; 
 
 IF param_in = 'PROD_VOL' THEN
 IF (:pr_details.initial_prod_vol >= l_setValues.min_vol) AND (:pr_details.initial_prod_vol <= l_setValues.max_vol) THEN
 l_failStatus := FALSE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF param_in = 'PLT_CNT' THEN
 IF (:pr_details.init_plt_count >= l_setValues.min_plt_count) AND (:pr_details.init_plt_count <= l_setValues.max_plt_count) THEN
 l_failStatus := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_failStatus;
END plt_typeset_fail;

PROCEDURE populate_bleed_times IS
 -- Populate Bleed start and end times.
 CURSOR units_cur IS
 select bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :CTRL_UNIT.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 l_bleedStartTime DATE;
 l_bleedEndTime DATE; 
BEGIN
 
 --item_change('pr_details.bleed_start_time', 'E');
 --item_change('pr_details.bleed_end_time', 'E');

 :pr_details.bleed_start_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, l_bleedStartTime);
 :pr_details.bleed_end_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, l_bleedEndTime);
 
 /*

ProgramUnit.Name: PLACE_WELD_INTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE place_WELD_inter(p_suitProdCode IN VARCHAR2, p_weldProdCode IN VARCHAR2, p_procCOde IN VARCHAR2) IS
 -- p_suitProdCode -> used to query whether WELD/SEAL is okay or not.
 -- p_weldProdCode -> Used to palce WELD interdiction on the product
 -- SUITABILITY -> weldProdCode is same as suitProdCode.
 -- INTERMEDIATE -> weldProdCode is same as suitProdCode.
 -- FINAL -> weldProdCode is the final product code.

 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_placeInter VARCHAR2(1);
 
 CURSOR sterile_cur(proc_code_in VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM pathogen_sterile_docking
 WHERE unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID
 AND proc_code = proc_code_in
 AND suit_prod_code = p_suitProdCode
 AND NVL(weld_ok, 'N') = 'N'; 
BEGIN

 -- Check for WELD interdiction
 

 l_placeInter := 'N'; -- Default;
 
 -- ONLY FOR FIRST SCREEN
 IF p_procCode = globalvar.c_SUITABILITY THEN
 -- Suitability WELD.
 l_recFound := FALSE;
 OPEN sterile_cur(globalvar.c_SUITABILITY);
 FETCH sterile_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := sterile_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE sterile_cur; 
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 l_placeInter := 'Y';
 END IF;
 
 -- PSORALEN WELD/SEAL.
 l_recFound := FALSE;
 OPEN sterile_cur(globalvar.c_PSORALEN);
 FETCH sterile_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := sterile_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE sterile_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 l_placeInter := 'Y';
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
 
 -- ONLY FOR SECOND SCREEN.
 IF p_procCode = globalvar.c_ILLUMINATION THEN
 -- WELD.
 l_recFound := FALSE;
 OPEN sterile_cur(globalvar.c_ILLUMINATION);
 FETCH sterile_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := sterile_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE sterile_cur; 
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 l_placeInter := 'Y';
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
 -- ONLY FOR THIRD SCREEN
 IF p_procCode = globalvar.c_CAD THEN
 -- WELD.
 l_recFound := FALSE;
 OPEN sterile_cur(globalvar.c_CAD);
 FETCH sterile_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := sterile_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE sterile_cur; 
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 l_placeInter := 'Y';
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 
 -- Place Interdiction only if WELD_YN is 'N'
 IF l_placeInter = 'Y' THEN
 place_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => p_weldProdCode);
 END IF; 
END;

 exception

 :sterile_docking_ctrl.weld_machine := l_weldMachine;--:sterile_docking_ctrl.weld_machine,

 -- store the state to track updates.
 GLOBALVAR.rec_sterile_bu.weld_machine := l_weldMachine;

 DELETE FROM component_interdictions

 */

ProgramUnit.Name: CALCULATE_INTENTED_USE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE calculate_intented_use(in_unit_id IN VARCHAR2, temp_v_prod_code in varchar2, out_prod_code out varchar2) IS
 szUnitAttr varchar2(20);
 szIntUse varchar2(10);
 prod_code varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 /* ********************************************************************************************
 Intented Use field setting-Sixth position of the product code: By Edwin (08/16/05)
 ******************************************************************************************** */
 Begin 
 select attrib_code into szUnitAttr from unit_attributes where
 unit_id= in_unit_id and attrib_group='DON';
 Exception 
 WHEN others then
 szUnitAttr:=null;
 End;

 IF szUnitAttr is not null then
 Begin
 select code_desc into szIntUse from master_codes where
 code_type='IUSE' and code=szUnitAttr and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then
 szIntUse := 'V';
 prod_code:=temp_v_prod_code||'V'||'00';
 When others then
 szIntUse := 'V';
 prod_code:=temp_v_prod_code||'V'||'00';
 End;

 If length(szIntUse) > 1 then
 show_error('9935');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 prod_code:=temp_v_prod_code||szIntUse||'00';
 End If;

 Else
 prod_code:=temp_v_prod_code||'V'||'00';
 End If; 

 out_prod_code :=prod_code;

 ---Intented use Ends here 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_PRD_STATUS_BLOCK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_prd_status_block IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;

 CURSOR prd_status_cur IS
 SELECT unit_id, cad_prod_code, vol_type_set,
 cad_start_time, cad_end_time, tdiff,
 CASE 
 WHEN tdiff >= max_cad_time-1 AND tdiff <= max_cad_time THEN 1
 WHEN tdiff < max_cad_time-1 AND tdiff >= min_cad_time THEN 2
 WHEN tdiff < min_cad_time THEN 3
 WHEN tdiff > max_cad_time THEN 4
 ELSE 5 END priority 
 FROM (
 SELECT unit_id, cad_prod_code, vol_type_set,
 cad_start_time, 
 cad_end_time,
 (SYSDATE-cad_start_time)*24 tdiff,
 min_cad_time, max_cad_time
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.cad_end_time IS NULL
 AND vprc.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND pred.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND pred.cad_start_time IS NOT NULL
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1)
 AND NOT EXISTS -- added sql to not look at rejected components.
 (SELECT 1
 FROM components comp
 WHERE comp.unit_id = pred.unit_id
 AND SUBSTR(comp.product_code, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(pred.cad_prod_code, 1, 5)
 AND comp.reject_reason_code IS NOT NULL) 
 )
 ORDER BY priority, tdiff;

BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('prd_status_ctrl');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(no_validate);
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 first_record;
 
 FOR prd_status_rec IN prd_status_cur 
 LOOP
 :prd_status_ctrl.unit_id := prd_status_rec.unit_id;
 :prd_status_ctrl.cad_prod_code := prd_status_rec.cad_prod_code;
 :prd_status_ctrl.vol_type_set := prd_status_rec.vol_type_set;
 :prd_status_ctrl.cad_start_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, prd_status_rec.cad_start_time);
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_cad_total_time := prd_status_rec.tdiff;
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_priority := prd_status_rec.priority;
 
 IF prd_status_rec.priority = 1 THEN
 SET_ITEM_INSTANCE_PROPERTY('prd_status_ctrl.s_status', CURRENT_RECORD, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'YELLOW_BG_REC');
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_status := 'READY - Almost overdue.';
 ELSIF prd_status_rec.priority = 2 THEN
 SET_ITEM_INSTANCE_PROPERTY('prd_status_ctrl.s_status', CURRENT_RECORD, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'GREEN_BG_REC');
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_status := 'READY - Within acceptable range.';
 ELSIF prd_status_rec.priority = 3 THEN
 SET_ITEM_INSTANCE_PROPERTY('prd_status_ctrl.s_status', CURRENT_RECORD, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'GREY_BG_REC');
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_status := 'WAIT - Not in acceptable range.';
 ELSIF prd_status_rec.priority = 4 THEN 
 SET_ITEM_INSTANCE_PROPERTY('prd_status_ctrl.s_status', CURRENT_RECORD, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'RED_BG_REC');
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_status := 'DISCARD - Exceeded the CAD time.';
 ELSE
 :prd_status_ctrl.s_status := 'N/A';
 END IF;
 
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 
 first_record;
 
END;
