ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_CNT_WT_VOL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_cnt_wt_vol(pl_prodCat IN VARCHAR2, pl_prodCode IN VARCHAR2) IS 
/*
-- Populates below fields.
pr_details.init_plt_count
pr_details.initial_prod_weight
pr_details.initial_prod_vol
pr_details.anticoagulant_volume
*/
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 cmp_cnt NUMBER;
 nPLTCount NUMBER;
 nProdWt NUMBER;
 nAntiCogVol NUMBER;
 nGravity NUMBER; 
 
 CURSOR cmp_cur IS
 SELECT component_count, component_weight, anticoagulant_volume
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND SUBSTR(product_code, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(pl_prodCode, 1, 5);
 
 CURSOR products_cur IS
 SELECT NVL(specific_gravity,1)
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = SUBSTR(pl_prodCode, 1, 5)
 AND chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate +1);
BEGIN
 --execute_trigger('validate_field');
 --check_package_failure;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, SYSDATE);
 
 OPEN cmp_cur;
 FETCH cmp_cur INTO nPLTCount, nProdWt, nAntiCogVol; 
 CLOSE cmp_cur;
 
 -- Assign Platelet count only for PLATELET Product type. 
 IF pl_prodCat = 'PLT' THEN -- platelet count is expressed as 10x10 in components table. Here it is 10 x 11
 :pr_details.init_plt_count := (nPLTCount/10);
 IF nPLTCount IS NOT NULL THEN
 item_change('pr_details.init_plt_count', 'D');
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 
 IF nProdWt IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pr_details.initial_prod_weight := nProdWt;
 
 nGravity := prod_gravity(pl_prodCode); -- function returns gravity
 
 IF nGravity IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pr_details.initial_prod_vol := nProdWt / NVL(nGravity,1);
 END IF;
 
 item_change('pr_details.initial_prod_weight', 'D');
 item_change('pr_details.initial_prod_vol', 'D');
 END IF;
 
 IF nAntiCogVol IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pr_details.anticoagulant_volume := nAntiCogVol;
 item_change('pr_details.anticoagulant_volume', 'D');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLAS_TYPESET_FAIL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION plas_typeset_fail(param_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 l_failStatus BOOLEAN := TRUE;

 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT min_vol, max_vol--, min_plt_count, max_plt_count, min_cad_time, max_cad_time, max_storage_days
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config
 WHERE volume_type_set = :pr_details.vol_type_set
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 --AND suspension_type = :pr_details.suspension_type
 --AND equip_type = :pr_details.equip_type
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 
 l_setValues vprc_cur%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.vol_type_set IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO l_setValues;
 CLOSE vprc_cur; 
 
 IF param_in = 'PROD_VOL' THEN
 IF (:pr_details.initial_prod_vol >= l_setValues.min_vol) AND (:pr_details.initial_prod_vol <= l_setValues.max_vol) THEN
 l_failStatus := FALSE;
 END IF;
 /*
 ELSIF param_in = 'PLT_CNT' THEN
 IF (:pr_details.init_plt_count >= l_setValues.min_plt_count) AND (:pr_details.init_plt_count <= l_setValues.max_plt_count) THEN
 l_failStatus := FALSE;
 END IF;
 */
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_failStatus;
END plas_typeset_fail;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_API_FIELDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_api_fields(p_unit_id IN VARCHAR2, p_suitProdCode IN VARCHAR2, p_api_status OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 CURSOR api_cur IS 
 SELECT product_code, instrument_code, lot_number,
 treatment_start_time, total_treatment_time, 
 operator_id, status, inst_message_code
 FROM api_pathogen_reduction
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 and product_code = p_suitProdCode;
 
 api_rec api_cur%ROWTYPE;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 p_api_status := 'N';
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_Convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 OPEN api_cur;
 FETCH api_cur INTO api_rec;
 l_recFound := api_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE api_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 p_api_status := 'Y';
 
 IF api_rec.product_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF api_rec.product_code <> NVL(:pi_details.suit_prod_code, api_rec.product_code) THEN
 show_error('0458');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 :pi_details.suit_prod_code := api_rec.product_code;
 
 --item_change('pi_details.suit_prod_code', 'D');
 --ELSE
 --item_change('pi_details.suit_prod_code','E');
 END IF;
 
 IF api_rec.instrument_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 begin 
 :pi_details.s_serial_number := api_rec.instrument_code;
 
 select equip_type, equip_reference, mc.code_desc
 into :pi_details.s_equip_type, :pi_details.illuminator_reference, :pi_details.s_equip_type_desc
 from equipment eq, equip_master_codes mc
 where serial_number = api_rec.instrument_code
 and eq.equip_type = mc.code
 and mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and chp_sysdate between first_production_date and 
 nvl(last_production_date, chp_sysdate + 1) and status = 'IN'
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate+1) 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; -- IM 280
 exception 
 when others then
 :pi_details.s_equip_type := null;
 :pi_details.illuminator_reference := null;
 :pi_details.s_equip_type_desc := null;
 end;
 END IF; 
 
 IF :pi_details.s_equip_type IS NOT NULL THEN
 item_change('pi_details.s_equip_type', 'D');
 --item_change('pi_details.s_equip_type_desc', 'D');
 item_change('pi_details.s_serial_number', 'D');
 item_change('pi_details.s_equip_reference', 'D');
 ELSE
 item_change('pi_details.s_equip_type', 'E');
 --item_change('pi_details.s_equip_type_desc', 'E');
 item_change('pi_details.s_serial_number', 'E');
 item_change('pi_details.s_equip_reference', 'E');
 END IF;
 
 /*
 --
 -- Volume Type Set populated from first screen
 -- it is made display only in init_view.
 
 --
 -- IM 261
 IF api_rec.lot_number IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF api_rec.lot_number <> NVL(:pi_details.set_id_lot_no, api_rec.lot_number) THEN
 p_err_code := NULL;
 item_change('pi_details.set_id_lot_no', 'E');

 --show_error('0470');
 --check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ---
 */ 
 
 IF api_rec.treatment_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pi_details.s_treatment_date := api_rec.treatment_start_time;
 :pi_details.s_treatment_time := api_rec.treatment_start_time;
 item_change('pi_details.s_treatment_date', 'D');
 item_change('pi_details.s_treatment_time', 'D');
 ELSE
 :pi_details.s_treatment_date := chp_sysdate;
 item_change('pi_details.s_treatment_date', 'E');
 item_change('pi_details.s_treatment_time', 'E'); 
 END IF;
 
 IF api_rec.total_treatment_time IS NOT NULL THEN 
 :pi_details.treatment_time := api_rec.total_treatment_time;
 :pi_details.s_total_treatment_time := TO_DATE(:pi_details.treatment_time,'hh24:mi');
 item_change('pi_details.s_total_treatment_time','D');
 ELSE
 item_change('pi_details.s_total_treatment_time', 'E');
 END IF;
 
 IF api_rec.status IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pi_details.illumination_status := api_rec.status; 
 item_change('pi_details.illumination_status','D');
 
 SELECT DECODE(api_rec.status, 1, 'Complete', 0, 'InComplete', NULL)
 INTO :pi_details.illumination_status_desc
 FROM dual;
 ELSE
 item_change('pi_details.illumination_status','E');
 END IF;
 IF :pi_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN -- Not required for PLASMA 
 :pi_details.s_cad_start_date := chp_sysdate;
 END IF;
 
 IF api_rec.operator_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pi_details.operator_id := api_rec.operator_id; 
 item_change('pi_details.operator_id','D');
 ELSE
 item_change('pi_details.operator_id','E');
 END IF;
 
 
 IF api_rec.inst_message_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 :pi_details.s_inst_msg := api_rec.inst_message_code; 
 item_change('pi_details.s_inst_msg','D');
 ELSE
 item_change('pi_details.s_inst_msg','E');
 END IF;
 
 ELSE -- record not fond in api table.
 IF :pi_details.s_treatment_date IS NULL THEN
 :pi_details.s_treatment_date := chp_sysdate;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pi_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN -- Not required for PLASMA
 :pi_details.s_cad_start_date := chp_sysdate;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 RAISE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GO_NAVIGABLE_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE go_navigable_item IS
BEGIN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.s_equip_reference', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_equip_reference');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.s_serial_number', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_serial_number');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.set_id_lot_no', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.set_id_lot_no');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.operator_id', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.operator_id');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.s_treatment_time', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_treatment_time'); 
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.s_total_treatment_time', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_total_treatment_time');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.illumination_status', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.illumination_status'); 
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.s_inst_msg', NAVIGABLE ) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_inst_msg');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.pb_rem_illumination', ENABLED ) = 'TRUE' THEN 
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.pb_rem_illumination');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.cad_prod_code', NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.cad_prod_code');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details.s_cad_start_time', NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_cad_start_time');
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details_ctrl.pb_reject', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN 
 GO_ITEM('pi_details_ctrl.pb_reject'); 
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pi_details_ctrl.pb_save', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN 
 GO_ITEM('pi_details_ctrl.pb_save');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('pi_details_ctrl.pb_exit'); 
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GO_NEXT_NULL_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GO_NEXT_NULL_ITEM IS
 FUNCTION is_item_navigable(item_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 BEGIN 
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(item_in, NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END is_item_navigable;
BEGIN
 IF :pi_details.illuminator_reference IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_equiKp_reference');
 ELSIF :pi_details.set_id_lot_no IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.set_id_lot_no');
 ELSIF :pi_details.operator_id IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.operator_id');
 ELSIF :pi_details.s_treatment_time IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_treatment_time');
 ELSIF :pi_details.s_total_treatment_time IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_total_treatment_time');
 ELSIF :pi_details.illumination_status IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.illumination_status');
 ELSIF :pi_details.s_inst_msg IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_inst_msg');
 ELSIF :pi_details.cad_prod_code IS NULL AND is_item_navigable('pi_details.cad_prod_code') THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.cad_prod_code');
 ELSIF :pi_details.s_cad_start_date IS NULL AND is_item_navigable('pi_details.s_cad_start_date') THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_cad_start_date');
 ELSIF :pi_details.s_cad_start_time IS NULL AND is_item_navigable('pi_details.s_cad_start_time') THEN
 GO_ITEM('pi_details.s_cad_start_time');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('pi_details_ctrl.pb_save');
 END IF; 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_COMP_PIMGR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure INSERT_COMP_PIMGR (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date ,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_bag_id in varchar2,
 p_old_product_code in varchar2,
 p_process in varchar2,
 p_weight in number ) is
 -- SAME AS INSERT_COMPONENT routine in library except that the code to place interdictions is commented out
 -- ALSO we only use DEFINE process in this routine.
 
 -- P_OLD_PRODUCT_CODE is an overloaded field used as follows
 -- depending on P_PROCESS:
 -- MODIFY CONVERT SPIKED stores old product code
 -- DEFINE stores number of bags used
 -- REJECT stores the reject reason_code
 temp_time_limit number(10,2);
 temp_max_temp number(10,2);
 temp_min_temp number(10,2);
 temp_min_weight number(10,2);
 temp_max_weight number(10,2);
 temp_old_exp_date date;
 temp_new_exp_date date;
 p_old_exp_date date;
 p_new_exp_date date;
 temp_process_date date;
 temp_life_span_ind varchar2(1);
 temp_life_span varchar2(4); 
 temp_attrib_code varchar2(8);
 temp_attr_count number;
 temp_checkin_min_temp number(10,2);
 temp_checkin_max_temp number(10,2);
 temp_wh_max_checkout_temp number(5,2);
 temp_wh_min_checkout_temp number(5,2); 
 temp_wh_max_checkin_temp number(5,2);
 temp_wh_min_checkin_temp number(5,2);
 temp_max_bleed_time number;
 temp_slow_bleed_time number;
 temp_bags_used number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_first_sep_time date;
 temp_second_sep_time date;
 temp_third_sep_time date;
 temp_cryo_time date;
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_pheresis_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(9);
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_old_product_type varchar2(5);
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_ffp_freeze_durn VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_calculated_time VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_p_name varchar2(30) := name_in('banner.prog_name'); 
 temp_u_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id'); 
 temp_comp_prefix varchar2(2);
 temp_discard varchar2(2);
 temp_warehouse varchar2(1) := name_in('GLOBAL.warehouse');
 temp_blfa_flag varchar2(1);
 inter_placed_flag varchar2(1);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 temp_inter_code number;
 szStatus varchar2(240);
 szIAuto varchar2(5);
 p_inter_prod_code varchar2(10);
 x_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 x_life_span NUMBER:=0;
 EXPAT_place VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN

 copy(p_unit_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 copy(p_chapter_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 copy(to_char(p_coll_date),'GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 copy(p_product_code,'GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 inter_placed_flag := 'N'; -- Flag set 'Y' if a temperature interdiction is placed
 
 
 
 -- check if auto interdiction should be placed or not (LT 2013) SCR: 18892
 Begin
 select nvl(parameter_value,'N') into szIAuto from valid_parameters where parameter_code='IAUTO'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+2);
 Exception when others then 
 szIAuto :='N';
 End;
 
 
 
 BEGIN
 select ffp_freeze_durn, max_bleed_time, slow_bleed_time
 into temp_ffp_freeze_durn, temp_max_bleed_time, temp_slow_bleed_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in selecting from chapter');
 handle_error;
 END;
 IF NVL(length(p_product_code), 0) = 8 or NVL(length(p_old_product_code), 0) = 8 THEN
 temp_comp_prefix := substr(p_product_code,-2);
 temp_discard := 'Md';
 ELSE
 temp_comp_prefix := '1';
 temp_discard := '47';
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 select max_temp, min_temp, time_limit, product_type,
 nvl(pheresis_flag,'N')
 into temp_max_temp, temp_min_temp,
 temp_time_limit, temp_product_type, temp_pheresis_flag
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(p_product_code,1,5)
 and --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 /* Get the expiration date of the old product_code, if the expiration date is null in the
 components table calculate it using coll date and life span- Added by Sobha*/
 BEGIN
 SELECT expiry_date
 INTO p_old_exp_date
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND coll_date = p_coll_date
 AND product_code = p_old_product_code
 AND chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 
 --MESSAGE('P_OLD_EXP_DATE='||to_char(p_old_exp_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi')); pause;
 
 IF p_old_exp_date is null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT decode(life_span_ind,'D', (p_coll_date + life_span)+.9999,
 'Y',(add_months(p_coll_date, life_span*12)+.9999),
 'H', p_coll_date + (life_span/24), p_coll_date)
 INTO temp_old_exp_date
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(p_old_product_code, 1, 5) 
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(length(p_unit_id),7,'C','I')
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 EXCEPTION 
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 ELSE
 temp_old_exp_date := p_old_exp_date;
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END; 
/* Sobha's code ends*/
 /* ADDED to Handle Product type change, only done for processes not equal to DEFINE */
 IF p_process not in ('DEFINE','REJECT') THEN
 BEGIN
 select product_type
 into temp_old_product_type
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(p_old_product_code,1,5) 
 and --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 select first_sep_time, second_sep_time,
 third_sep_time, bleed_start_time,
 bleed_end_time, contract_id
 into temp_first_sep_time, temp_second_sep_time,
 temp_third_sep_time, temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_bleed_end_time, temp_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 units.chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF temp_contract_id = 'INTERNAL' 
 THEN
 IF temp_max_temp is not null or 
 temp_min_temp is not null
 THEN
 -- message('Entered check for temperature interdiction');
 BEGIN
 select min_temp, max_temp
 into temp_checkin_min_temp,
 temp_checkin_max_temp
 from batch_inputs, units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(p_coll_date) and
 units.chapter_id = p_chapter_id and
 units.batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id and
 batch_inputs.chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from batch_inputs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 /*
 IF temp_checkin_min_temp < nvl(temp_min_temp,-9999) or 
 temp_checkin_max_temp > nvl(temp_max_temp,9999)
 THEN
 show_error('9789','CMT');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date ,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 'CMT',temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name);
 inter_placed_flag := 'Y';
 IF temp_return_val != '0'
 THEN
 inter_placed_flag := 'N';
 message('1-Interdictions CMT not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 */
 /*
 IF inter_placed_flag = 'N' THEN
 -- Check whether the warehouse checkout temp is between 
 -- temp_max_temp and temp_min_temp 
 BEGIN
 select min(checkout_temp), max(checkout_temp)
 into temp_wh_min_checkout_temp, temp_wh_max_checkout_temp
 from lab_wh_trans_hdr 
 where batch_id in(select batch_id from 
 lab_wh_trans_dtl
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and product_code is null
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 temp_wh_min_checkout_temp := null;
 temp_wh_max_checkout_temp := null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from lab_wh_trans_hdr');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF temp_wh_min_checkout_temp is not null THEN 
 IF temp_wh_min_checkout_temp < nvl(temp_min_temp,-9999) or 
 temp_wh_max_checkout_temp > nvl(temp_max_temp,9999) THEN
 show_error('9789','CMT');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 'CMT',temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name);
 inter_placed_flag := 'Y';
 IF temp_return_val != '0'
 THEN
 inter_placed_flag := 'N';
 message('2-Interdictions CMT not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 */
 /*
 IF inter_placed_flag = 'N' then
 --Check whether the warehouse checkin temp is between 
 --temp_max_temp and temp_min_temp 
 
 BEGIN
 select min(receive_temp), max(receive_temp)
 into temp_wh_min_checkin_temp, temp_wh_max_checkin_temp
 from lab_wh_trans_dtl 
 where unit_id = p_unit_id 
 and product_code is null
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 temp_wh_min_checkin_temp := null; 
 temp_wh_max_checkin_temp := null; 
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from lab_wh_trans_dtl');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF temp_wh_min_checkin_temp is not null then
 if temp_wh_min_checkin_temp < nvl(temp_min_temp,-9999) or 
 temp_wh_max_checkin_temp > nvl(temp_max_temp,9999) THEN

 show_error('9789','CMT');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date ,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 'CMT',temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name);
 inter_placed_flag := 'Y'; 
 IF temp_return_val != '0'
 THEN
 inter_placed_flag := 'N'; 
 message('3-Interdictions CMT not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 */ 
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF temp_pheresis_flag = 'N' and
 temp_contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 THEN
 IF temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 THEN
 IF temp_first_sep_time is null or
 temp_second_sep_time is null
 THEN
 show_error('0138');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('WB','DUWB')
 THEN
 IF temp_first_sep_time is not null
 THEN
 show_error('0260');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPL','RPFF',
 'DUFFP','DURPL','DURPF','PLSM')
 THEN
 IF temp_first_sep_time is null
 THEN
 show_error('0083');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('FFP','DUFFP')
 THEN
 IF temp_first_sep_time is not null and
 temp_second_sep_time is not null and
 temp_third_sep_time is not null
 THEN
 show_error('0079');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 THEN
 IF temp_first_sep_time is null
 THEN
 show_error('0084');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF temp_time_limit is not null
 THEN
 -- message('Entered check for time interdiciton');
 IF temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 THEN
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_first_sep_time);
 
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 THEN
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_second_sep_time);
 -- message('b1:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('CRYO','DUCRYO')
 THEN
 BEGIN
 select decode(sep_ind,2,temp_second_sep_time,
 3,temp_third_sep_time,null)
 into temp_cryo_time
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date);
 IF temp_cryo_time is null
 THEN
 message ('no data selecting from cryo units');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 message ('error selecting from cryo units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_cryo_time);
 -- message('b2:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 END IF;
 IF temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPFF','RPL','DUFFP','DURPF','PLSM')
 THEN
 IF temp_second_sep_time is not null
 THEN
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_second_sep_time);
 --message('c:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 ELSE
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_first_sep_time);
 --message('d:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 END IF;
 END IF;
/* Added by sobha PR No.001.031571 */
 IF (temp_product_type = 'WB') THEN
 temp_time_difference :=sbclib.calculate_time(trunc(temp_bleed_start_time,'MI'),trunc(sysdate,'MI'));
 END IF; 
 
 IF temp_product_type = 'PLSM' THEN
 DECLARE
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 BEGIN
 select 'x' into temp_x
 from dual
 where exists
 (select 'x' from components c,valid_products vp
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and substr(c.product_code,1,5) = vp.product_code
 and vp.product_type = 'CRYO'
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id);
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('9793');
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 -- message('h:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 copy('N','GLOBAL.time_interdiction');
 IF temp_time_difference is null

 --The cursor is becase, the same program insert the same interdiction by calling the SBCLIB package , so we have do the conditional update

 DECLARE
 vCount NUMBER:=0;
 CURSOR cur_inter is select * from component_interdictions where unit_id=p_unit_id and program_id!='AUTOINT' and
 product_code=p_old_product_code for update of inter_code;

 BEGIN
 for Z in cur_inter loop
 select nvl(count(*),0) into vCount from component_interdictions where
 inter_code=Z.inter_code and product_code=p_product_code and program_id!='AUTOINT' and unit_id=p_unit_id;
 If vCount =0 then 
 
 update component_interdictions
 set product_code = p_product_code,
 program_id = temp_p_name
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 chapter_id = p_chapter_id and
 product_code = p_old_product_code and 
 inter_code=Z.inter_code; 
 ---message('Old product code='||p_old_product_code);pause;
 end if;
 end loop; 
 
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 chapter_id = p_chapter_id and
 product_code = p_old_product_code;
 
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error updating in the component_interdiction');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 /* get the expiration date according to the attributes*/
 
 
 DECLARE 
 cursor c1 is SELECT attrib_group, attrib_code, proc_date, insert_dats
 FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND coll_date = p_coll_date
 AND chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND product_code = p_product_code;
 
 pl_life_span_ind varchar2(1);
 pl_base_proc_date date;
 pl_life_span varchar2(4);
 pl_chap_proc_date date;
 
 BEGIN
 FOR c1rec in c1
 LOOP
 BEGIN 
 
 /* SELECT decode(life_span_ind,'D', nvl(c1rec.proc_date,c1rec.insert_dats) + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(c1rec.proc_date,c1rec.insert_dats), life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(c1rec.proc_date,c1rec.insert_dats)+(life_span / 24))
 INTO p_new_exp_date
 FROM valid_product_attributes
 WHERE product_type = temp_product_type 
 AND attrib_group = c1rec.attrib_group
 AND attrib_code = c1rec.attrib_code
 AND life_span is not null
 AND life_span_ind is not null
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y'; */
 
 SELECT life_span_ind, nvl(c1rec.proc_date,c1rec.insert_dats) base_date ,life_span
 INTO pl_life_span_ind, pl_base_proc_date,pl_life_span
 FROM valid_product_attributes
 WHERE product_type = temp_product_type 
 AND attrib_group = c1rec.attrib_group
 AND attrib_code = c1rec.attrib_code
 AND life_span is not null
 AND life_span_ind is not null
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y'; 
 
 -----
 If is_timezone_enabled then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(p_chapter_id, pl_base_proc_date, pl_chap_proc_date);
 Else
 pl_chap_proc_date:=pl_base_proc_date;
 End If;
 
 
 
 IF pl_life_span_ind = 'D' THEN
 p_new_exp_date := trunc(pl_chap_proc_date)+(to_number(pl_life_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 END IF;
 
 IF pl_life_span_ind = 'Y' THEN
 p_new_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(pl_chap_proc_date), 12* to_number(pl_life_span));
 END IF;
 
 IF pl_life_span_ind = 'H' THEN
 p_new_exp_date := pl_chap_proc_date +(to_number(pl_life_span)/24);
 END IF;
 
 ------ 
 
 
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 null;
 END;
--message('p-'||to_char(p_new_exp_date, 'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;
--message('temp-'||to_char(temp_new_exp_date, 'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;

 IF temp_new_exp_date is null THEN
 temp_new_exp_date := p_new_exp_date;
 ELSIF temp_new_exp_date > p_new_exp_date THEN
 temp_new_exp_date := p_new_exp_date;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 

 /* If the expiration of old product code is less than the expiration calculated from the attributes
 recalculate process date and insert an attribute in components attributes with that process date
 to take care of the old expiration date while labelling*/

 --message('Old Exp-'||to_char(temp_old_exp_date, 'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi')); 
 --message('New Exp-'||to_char(temp_new_exp_date , 'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi'));
 
 
 --IF temp_old_exp_date < temp_new_exp_date then -- Commented by Kishore on 12/03/2013. IM 9809, IM 9812
 -- if temp_old_exp_date < nvl(temp_new_exp_date, temp_old_exp_date + 1) then -- Added by Kishore on 12/03/2013. IM 9809, IM 9812 (This was commented by Edwin again to revert the change back, we cannot use teh NVL clauss here- Check with Edwin )
 -- IF temp_old_exp_date < temp_new_exp_date then -- commented out and included the OR condition below for IM 10315 : Edwin
 
 IF (temp_old_exp_date <= temp_new_exp_date) OR (temp_old_exp_date is not null and temp_new_exp_date is null) then -- the equal was added later on 01/20/15
 BEGIN
 SELECT life_span_ind, life_span, attrib_code
 INTO temp_life_span_ind, temp_life_span, temp_attrib_code
 FROM valid_product_attributes
 WHERE attrib_code in (SELECT code FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'EXPAT'
 AND --sysdate between eff_date AND nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y')
 AND attrib_group = 'SP' 
 AND product_type = temp_product_type
 AND --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in selecting from Valid Product Attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 IF temp_life_span_ind = 'D' THEN
 temp_process_date := temp_old_exp_date - (1*temp_life_span);
 ELSIF temp_life_span_ind = 'H' THEN
 temp_process_date := temp_old_exp_date - (temp_life_span/24); 
 ELSIF temp_life_span_ind = 'Y' THEN
 temp_process_date := add_months(temp_old_exp_date, (-1*temp_life_span*12));
 END IF;

 -- check if the product expires in Years or not (not to place the PEXEC on 10 or more year exp date)
 x_life_span_ind:=null;
 
 select life_span_ind, life_span into x_life_span_ind, x_life_span from valid_products where 
 product_code=substr(p_product_code,1,5) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+50);
 
 If (x_life_span_ind='Y' and x_life_span>=10) then -- the If statmentet was added becuase it should not place the PEXC for the 10 year expiration date (10/06/14)
 null;
 Else
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO temp_x
 FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND coll_date = p_coll_date
 AND chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND product_code = p_product_code
 AND attrib_group = 'SP'
 AND attrib_code = temp_attrib_code;

 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO component_attributes
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id, proc_date)
 VALUES
 (p_unit_id, p_coll_date, p_chapter_id,p_product_code,
 'SP', temp_attrib_code, sysdate, temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name, temp_process_date);
 
 --MESSAGE('PEXC has been created for '||p_product_code);
 
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in inserting into component attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 
 --message('Not placing the PEXC for this attribute');pause;
 End If; --10/06/14
 
 END IF; 
 END IF;
/* Sobha's code ends*/
 ---Added at BloodCare by Amit Bhagat on 08-28-97
 ---to handle matching attributes to the product_formula
 BEGIN
 UPDATE_COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES(p_unit_id, p_coll_date, p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code, temp_u_id, temp_p_name);
 END; 
 END;

FUNCTION comp_rejected(p_unitID IN VARCHAR2, p_collDate IN DATE, p_prodCode IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR reject_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = p_unitID
 AND coll_date = p_collDate
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = p_prodCode
 AND reject_reason_code IS NOT NULL
 AND program_id= 'CPIREJ';
 
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 
 IF p_prodCode IS NULL THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF; 
 
 OPEN reject_cur;

 l_recFound := reject_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE reject_cur;
 
 RETURN l_recFound;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_API_PATHOGEN_REDUCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_api_pathogen_reduction(p_unitID IN VARCHAR2, p_ProdCode in varchar2) IS
 api_updated BOOLEAN;
 apiarch_updated BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 UPDATE api_pathogen_reduction 
 SET record_status = 'C'
 WHERE unit_id=p_unitID and product_code=p_prodCode; 
 
 api_updated := SQL%ROWCOUNT > 0;
 
 IF api_updated THEN
 INSERT INTO api_pathogen_reduction_arch
 SELECT *
 FROM api_pathogen_reduction
 WHERE unit_id = p_unitID and product_code=p_prodCode; 
 
 apiarch_updated := SQL%ROWCOUNT > 0;
 
 IF apiarch_updated THEN
 DELETE FROM api_pathogen_reduction
 WHERE unit_id = p_unitID and product_code=p_prodCode; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Err ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM,1, 200));
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VOLUME_PIMGR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_volume_PIMGR
 (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date ,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_volume in number,
 p_prod_Category IN VARCHAR2,
 p_suit_prod_code IN VARCHAR2 ) is
 temp_max_weight number;
 temp_min_weight number;
 temp_u_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id');
 temp_p_name varchar2(30) := name_in('banner.prog_name');
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 n_final_minVol NUMBER;
 n_final_maxVol NUMBER;
 
 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT final_min_volume, final_max_volume
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND pred.suit_prod_code = p_suit_prod_code
 ANd vprc.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);

 CURSOR vprc_PLAS_cur IS 
 SELECT final_min_volume, final_max_volume
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 --AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 --AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND pred.suit_prod_code = p_suit_prod_code
 ANd vprc.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1); 
begin
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(p_chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 IF p_prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO n_final_minVol, n_final_maxVol;
 CLOSE vprc_cur;
 ELSIF p_prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 OPEN vprc_PLAS_cur;
 FETCH vprc_PLAS_cur INTO n_final_minVol, n_final_maxVol;
 CLOSE vprc_PLAS_cur;
 END IF;
 
 IF n_final_minVOl IS NULL OR n_final_maxVol IS NULL THEN
 message('Error in selecting final volume from Pathogen configuration table');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 --MESSAGE('VOLUME ' || P_VOLUME);PAUSE;
 --MESSAGE('VOLUME 1 ' || n_final_minVol);PAUSE;
 --MESSAGE('VOLUME 2' || n_final_maxVol);PAUSE;
 IF p_volume NOT BETWEEN n_final_minVol AND n_final_maxVol THEN
 show_error('9789','CMW');

 begin
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 inter_code, insert_dats, inter_user_id,
 program_id)
 select p_unit_id,p_coll_date,p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,inter_code,sysdate,
 temp_u_id,temp_p_name
 from valid_interdictions_lab --- LT 2018
 where system_inter_code = 'CMW' and
 inter_code not in (select inter_code
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(p_coll_date)
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message ('Error in inserting into comp_inter');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 ELSE
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date)
 and product_code = p_product_code 
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select inter_code 
 from valid_interdictions_lab -- LT 2018
 where system_inter_code = 'CMW'
 and --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y');

 END IF; 
 
END;

procedure check_count_PIMGR

 n_final_minCnt NUMBER;
 n_final_maxCnt NUMBER;

 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT final_min_plt_count, final_max_plt_count
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type

 AND pred.suit_prod_code = p_suit_prod_code
 AND vprc.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);

 CURSOR vprc_PLAS_cur IS 
 SELECT final_min_plt_count, final_max_plt_count
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 --AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 --AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND pred.suit_prod_code = p_suit_prod_code
 AND vprc.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 
begin
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(p_chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 IF p_prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO n_final_minCnt, n_final_maxCnt;
 CLOSE vprc_cur;
 ELSIF p_prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN

 IF n_final_minCnt IS NULL OR n_final_maxCnt IS NULL THEN
 message('Error in selecting final Platelet Count from Pathogen configuration table');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF p_count NOT BETWEEN n_final_minCnt AND n_final_maxCnt THEN
 show_error('9789','CMCO');
 l_return := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id,
 :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :pf_products.prod_code,
 'CMCO',
 :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if l_return != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CMCO not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 END IF; 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_LOC_CODES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_loc_codes(p_err_msg OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 l_err VARCHAR2(20);
 
 CURSOR file_loc_cur(code_in VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT code_desc
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'LOGDR'
 AND code = code_in
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 OPEN file_loc_cur('PILOC');
 FETCH file_loc_cur INTO globalvar.l_file_loc;
 CLOSE file_loc_cur;
 
 OPEN file_loc_cur('PIARC');
 FETCH file_loc_cur INTO globalvar.l_archive_loc;
 CLOSE file_loc_cur;
 
 l_err := NULL;
 
 IF globalvar.l_file_loc IS NULL THEN
 l_err := '- PILOC';
 ELSE
 globalvar.l_file_loc := RTRIM(globalvar.l_file_loc,' ') || ' '; -- Add a SPACE at the end. Webutil issue.
 END IF;
 
 IF globalvar.l_archive_loc IS NULL THEN
 IF l_err IS NULL THEN
 l_err := '- PIARC';
 ELSE
 l_err := l_err || ', PIARC';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF SUBSTR(GLOBALVAR.l_archive_loc,-1) <> '\' THEN
 GLOBALVAR.l_archive_loc := GLOBALVAR.l_archive_loc || '\';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 p_err_msg := l_err;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLIENT_TEXTIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE client_textio IS
 l_out_file client_Text_IO.File_Type;
 v_record varchar2(2000);
 
 v_insert_counter NUMBER;
 v_rec_counter NUMBER;
 
 l_filename varchar2(2000) ;-- := :global.user_home ||'\helloworld.txt';
 l_copy_name varchar2(2000) ;-- := :global.arlog_home ||'\copy of helloworld.txt';
 l_success boolean;

 err_code number;
 err_msg VARCHAR2(80);
 
 v_line_counter number;
 v_lifetrak_format varchar2(1) :='N';
 v_user_id varchar2(20);
 v_file_name varchar2(300);
BEGIN
 null;
/*
 v_line_counter:=0;
 l_out_file := client_Text_IO.Fopen(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name,'r');
 
 if substr(user,1,4) = 'OPS$' then
 v_user_id := substr(user,5,6);
 else
 v_user_id := substr(user,1,6);
 end if;
 
 v_file_name := substr(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name,instr(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name,'\',-1)+1,length(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name));
 
 LOOP
 client_text_io.get_line(l_out_file, v_record);
 
 --v_rec_counter :=v_rec_counter+1;
 
 -- the first record will have FH: if its a lifetrak format
 
 IF v_line_counter =0 and v_record is not null and v_lifetrak_format <>'Y' then
 IF substr(v_record,1,3) ='FH:' THEN 
 v_lifetrak_format :='Y';
 v_record := substr(v_record,1,13) ||:CHAPTER_ID||substr(v_record,17,length(v_record));
 END IF; 
 end if; 
 
 --IF v_record is not null THEN
 IF nvl(length(replace (v_record,' ','')),0) >0 THEN
 v_line_counter :=v_line_counter+1;
 
 insert into LT_INTERFACE_FILES (CHAPTER_ID, FILE_ID, DATA_STRING ,INSERT_DATE,line_order,lifetrak_format,INSERT_USER,EXTERNAL_SOURCE)
 values(:CHAPTER_ID,v_file_name,v_record,:s_date,v_line_counter, v_lifetrak_format,:banner.user_id,'DOD'); 
 

 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 client_text_io.fclose (l_out_file);
 commit;
 l_filename :=:s_file_name; -- :global.user_home||'\'||substr(:s_file_name,instr(:s_file_name,'\',-1)+1,length(:s_file_name));
 
 l_copy_name:=:global.arlog_home||'\'||substr(:s_file_name,instr(:s_file_name,'\',-1)+1,length(:s_file_name));
 
 l_success := webutil_file.copy_file(l_filename,l_copy_name);
 if l_success 
 then
 
 show_error('0410');
 
 l_success := webutil_file.delete_file(l_filename);
 if l_success 
 then
 --message('Delete of file successfull');
 message('Copy of file successfull');
 go_item('CTRL_BLOCK_1.CHAPTER_ID');
 :CHAPTER_ID :=null;
 :CHAPTER_NAME :=null;
 :S_FILE_NAME :=null;
 clear_message;
 else
 message('Delete failed');
 end if;
 
 
 else 
 message('Copy failed'); 
 end if;
 
 
 
 
 
 
 when others then
 
 show_error('0411');
 err_code := sqlcode;
 err_msg := substr(sqlerrm,1,75);
 rollback;
 insert into lifetrak_api_log(SOURCE_ID,INTERNAL_ID,LOG_TEXT,EXTERNAL_ID,INSERT_DATE,PROGRAM_ID )
 values('DOD','LIFETRAK',err_code||'-'||err_msg,:s_file_name,:s_date,'AIIFUPLD');
 
 commit;
 --message(:CHAPTER_ID||','||:s_file_name||','||v_record||','||sysdate);
 --message(:CHAPTER_ID||','||:s_file_name||','||v_record||','||sysdate); 
 
 
 --TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(file_handle);
 --client_text_io.get_line(l_out_file, v_record);
 --'At '||TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI')||' ' 
 -- ||webutil_clientinfo.get_user_name||' wrote:');
 
 --client_text_io.put_line(l_out_file, :builtins.text_io_item);
*/ 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPLOAD_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPLOAD_RESULTS IS
 l_success BOOLEAN;
 l_intercept_success BOOLEAN;
 l_copy_success BOOLEAN;
 l_delete_success BOOLEAN;
 ft_file Client_Text_IO.File_Type;
 v_line VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_file VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_dest_file VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_bare_file VARCHAR2(2000);
 err_msg VARCHAR2(80);
 l_error VARCHAR2(2000);
 
 
 PROCEDURE log_error(p_msg IN VARCHAR2, p_ext_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 insert into lifetrak_api_log(SOURCE_ID,INTERNAL_ID,LOG_TEXT,EXTERNAL_ID,INSERT_DATE,PROGRAM_ID )
 values('DOD','LIFETRAK',p_msg, p_ext_id, SYSDATE, 'CPIPRMGR'); 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 COMMIT; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 END; 

 -- IM 315
 -- BOM representation is EFBBBF in UTF-8 encoding
 -- This respresentation can change based on the encoding of the file.
 -- So instead of using SUBSTR - convert the string to HEX and search
 -- for 22 (which is hex for ").
 FUNCTION remove_BOM_marker(p_line IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 l_return VARCHAR2(4000);
 l_hex_string VARCHAR2(4000);
 BEGIN
 --l_BOM_marker := 'EFBBBF';
 l_return := p_line;
 l_hex_string := rawtohex(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(p_line));
 -- check for Byte Order Mark.
 l_hex_string := SUBSTR(l_hex_string, INSTR(l_hex_string, '22'));
 l_return := UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_VARCHAR2(l_hex_string);
 RETURN l_return;
 END remove_BOM_marker;
 /*
 FUNCTION remove_BOM_marker(p_line IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 l_start_hex VARCHAR2(100);
 l_return VARCHAR2(4000);
 l_sub_string VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 --l_BOM_marker := 'EFBBBF';
 l_return := p_line;
 l_sub_string := SUBSTR(p_line, 1, 3);
 l_start_hex := rawtohex(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(l_sub_string));
 IF l_start_hex = 'EFBBBF' THEN -- BOM Marker in UTF-8
 l_return := SUBSTR(p_line, 4); -- Ignore the first three characters.
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_return;
 END remove_BOM_marker; 
 */ 
BEGIN
 -- Open the file for reading;
 v_file := :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file;
 ft_file := Client_Text_IO.Fopen(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file,'R');
 v_bare_file := substr(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file,instr(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file,'\',-1)+1,length(:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file));
 
 --:pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name := v_bare_file;
 
 LOOP
 -- Read Line From file
 ------------
 Client_Text_IO.Get_Line(ft_file, v_line);
 v_line := remove_BOM_marker(v_line);
 IF v_line IS NOT NULL THEN
 EXIT;-- Exit after reading first line..
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 

 Client_Text_IO.FClose(ft_file);
 
 IF v_line IS NOT NULL THEN
 sbclib.intercept_data_parser( pl_inp_file_name => v_bare_file, 
 pl_inp_record => v_line,
 pl_chapter_id => :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 pl_user_id => :BANNER.user_id,
 pl_error => l_error
 );
 IF l_error = 'OK' THEN
 v_dest_file := GLOBALVAR.l_archive_loc || v_bare_file; 
 l_success := webutil_file.copy_file(v_file,v_dest_file); 
 IF l_success THEN
 l_success := webutil_file.delete_file(v_file);
 IF l_success THEN
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file := NULL;
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name := NULL;
 
 show_error('0461'); -- upload successful
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file := NULL;
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name := NULL;
 
 show_error('0462'); -- upload successful, but unable to copy to archive location
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file := NULL;
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name := NULL;
 
 show_error('0462');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 log_error(l_error, v_file);

 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file := NULL;
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name := NULL;

 show_error('0460', l_error); -- Upload failed. Error msg.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 -- End of file reached;
 Client_Text_IO.FClose(ft_file);
 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 IF Client_Text_IO.IS_OPEN(ft_file) THEN
 Client_Text_IO.FClose(ft_file);
 END IF;
 err_msg := sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm,1,75);
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 rollback;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 log_error(err_msg, v_file);
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file := NULL;
 :pi_upload_ctrl.s_file_name := NULL;
 show_error('0460', err_msg); -- Error in intercept log process, check log table.
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TRANSFER_COMPLETE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION TRANSFER_COMPLETE(p_unitID IN VARCHAR2, p_prodCode IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR api_arch_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM api_pathogen_reduction_arch
 WHERE unit_id = p_unitID
 AND product_code = p_prodCode;
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN; 
 
BEGIN
 OPEN api_arch_cur;
 FETCH api_arch_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := api_arch_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE api_arch_cur;
 
 RETURN l_recFound;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INTERMEDIATE_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE intermediate_check (
 pl_suitprodcode IN VARCHAR2
) IS

 CURSOR prd_cur IS
 SELECT
 nvl(suit_status_code, 'N'),
 cad_start_time,
 cad_end_time,
 suit_prod_code,
 prod_category
 FROM
 pathogen_reduction_details
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND suit_prod_code = nvl(pl_suitprodcode, suit_prod_code);

 CURSOR weld_cur IS
 SELECT
 1
 FROM
 component_interdictions
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND product_code = pl_suitprodcode
 AND inter_code = 'WELD'
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 CURSOR api_cur IS
 SELECT
 lot_number,
 instrument_code,
 status
 FROM
 api_pathogen_reduction apr
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND product_code = pl_suitprodcode;

 chp_sysdate DATE;
 CURSOR equip_cur (
 pl_instcode VARCHAR2
 ) IS
 SELECT
 1
 FROM
 equipment eq,
 equip_master_codes mc
 WHERE
 serial_number = pl_instcode
 AND eq.equip_type = mc.code
 AND mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN first_production_date AND nvl(last_production_date, chp_sysdate + 1)
 AND status = 'IN'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1)
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 CURSOR sterile_cur IS
 SELECT
 set_lot_no
 FROM
 pathogen_sterile_docking
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND suit_prod_code = pl_suitprodcode
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_suitability;

 l_statuscode VARCHAR2(1);
 l_cadstarttime DATE;
 l_cadendtime DATE;
 l_recfound BOOLEAN := false;
 l_ill_inserted BOOLEAN;
 l_api_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 l_suitprodcode VARCHAR2(8);
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_amo_inserted BOOLEAN;
 l_apirecfound BOOLEAN;
 l_lotno VARCHAR2(10);
 l_instcode VARCHAR2(15);
 l_apistatus VARCHAR2(1);
 l_equiprecfound BOOLEAN;
 l_sterilelotno VARCHAR2(10);
 l_prod_category VARCHAR2(10);
 
 PROCEDURE set_update_ITEMS IS
 BEGIN
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_SERIAL_NUMBER','E');
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_TREATMENT_DATE','E');
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_TREATMENT_TIME','E');
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.ILLUMINATION_STATUS','E');
 
 IF :pi_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_CAD_START_DATE','E'); 
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_CAD_START_TIME','E'); 
 END IF;
 
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_EQUIP_REFERENCE','D');
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_EQUIP_TYPE','D');
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.OPERATOR_ID','D');
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.S_INST_MSG','D'); 
 item_change('PI_DETAILS.CAD_PROD_CODE','D');
 
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PI_DETAILS_CTRL.PB_SAVE', LABEL, 'Update');
 
 END set_update_ITEMS;
BEGIN
 OPEN prd_cur;
 FETCH prd_cur INTO
 l_statuscode,
 l_cadstarttime,
 l_cadendtime,
 l_suitprodcode,
 l_prod_category;
 l_recfound := prd_cur%found;
 CLOSE prd_cur;
 
 
 IF NOT l_recfound THEN
 show_error('0426');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 IF nvl(l_statuscode, 'N') <> 'Y' THEN
 show_error('0429');
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSE 
 /* -- Update mode.
 IF l_cadendtime IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_error('0457');--final process started, do not allow to update.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 */ 
 
 -- IM 263
 -- check whether PSORALEN BAG IS REMOVED.
 BEGIN
 l_amo_inserted := sterile_inserted(:ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, globalvar.c_psoralen, l_suitprodcode);
 IF
 NOT l_amo_inserted
 AND globalvar.l_pi_seal_rq = 'Y'
 THEN
 show_error('0471'); -- Suitability Process is incomplete - Psoralen Bag removal pending.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 END; 
 ------------

 DECLARE
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 BEGIN
 globalvar.lb_update_mode := false;
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 IF l_prod_category = 'PLT' THEN 
 SELECT
 COUNT(1)
 INTO ln_cnt
 FROM
 valid_products v,
 pathogen_reduction_details prd,
 components c
 WHERE
 v.product_code = substr(prd.suit_prod_code, 1, 5)
 AND c.product_code = prd.suit_prod_code
 AND c.reject_reason_code IS NOT NULL
 AND nvl(v.pathogen_reduction_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND prd.unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND prd.suit_prod_code = :ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code
 AND prd.unit_id = c.unit_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN v.eff_date AND nvl(v.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1); 
 ELSE -- FOR PLAS products, ILLUMINATION BAG REMOVAL is the final step as they do not enter CAD Product.
 SELECT
 COUNT(1)
 INTO ln_cnt
 FROM
 pathogen_sterile_docking
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id
 AND suit_prod_code = :ctrl_pi_unit.suit_prod_code
 AND proc_code = GLOBALVAR.C_ILLUMINATION;
 END IF; 

 IF ln_cnt <> 0 THEN
 IF :FORMS_VAR.PRUP_ACCESS = 'N' THEN
 show_error('0478');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 globalvar.lb_update_mode := true;
 END IF;


 END; 

 -- IM 257 
 -- check for inter;
 globalvar.l_unitid := :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id;
 globalvar.l_colldate := :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date;
 globalvar.l_donorcode := get_donor_code;
 globalvar.l_prodcode := pl_suitprodcode;
 globalvar.l_prodtype := get_prod_type;
 
 IF inter_found THEN
 show_error('0243');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 -- IM 275
 IF comp_rejected(p_unitid => :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, p_colldate => :ctrl_pi_unit.coll_date, p_prodcode => pl_suitprodcode)
 THEN
 show_error('0005');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ------------- 
 
 IF NOT GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode THEN
 BEGIN
 -- IM 261 
 OPEN api_cur;
 FETCH api_cur INTO
 l_lotno,
 l_instcode,
 l_apistatus; -- IM 280
 l_apirecfound := api_cur%found;
 CLOSE api_cur;
 IF l_apirecfound THEN
 IF l_lotno IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN sterile_cur;
 FETCH sterile_cur INTO l_sterilelotno;
 CLOSE sterile_cur;
 IF l_sterilelotno <> l_lotno THEN
 show_error('0470');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- IM 280
 IF l_instcode IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 OPEN equip_cur(l_instcode);
 FETCH equip_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_equiprecfound := equip_cur%found;
 CLOSE equip_cur;
 IF NOT l_equiprecfound THEN
 show_error('0472');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- IM 280
 IF l_apistatus IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_apistatus NOT IN ( '0', '1' ) THEN
 show_error('0473');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 END IF; 
 END;
 ----
 END IF; 
 

 -- Need to display Suit Prod Code and Volume type set from first screens.
 go_block('pi_details');
 execute_query;
 IF :pi_details.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 item_change('pi_details.cad_prod_code', 'D');
 item_change('pi_details.s_cad_start_date', 'D');
 item_change('pi_details.s_cad_start_time', 'D');
 END IF;

 IF l_cadstarttime IS NULL THEN -- populates API fields if record is there other wise allow to enter manually.
 populate_api_fields(p_unit_id => :ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, 
 p_suitprodcode => :pi_details.suit_prod_code, 
 p_api_status => l_api_flag);-- flag is Y if populated from api table otherwise N.
 END IF;

 IF :pi_details.illumination_status IS NOT NULL THEN
 l_ill_inserted := sterile_inserted(:ctrl_pi_unit.unit_id, globalvar.c_illumination, l_suitprodcode);
 IF l_ill_inserted THEN
 enable_disable_item('pi_details.pb_rem_illumination', 'E');
 disp_item('pi_details_ctrl.illumination_lbl', 'Y');
 END IF;

 enable_disable_status_buttons;
 END IF;

 IF :pi_details.cad_prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 enable_disable_item('pi_details_ctrl.pb_print_label', 'E');
 
 -- IM 256
 -- store it in a variable;
 -- Used for updating suit prod code scenarios (we need to delete from components before updating product code)
 globalvar.bu_prodcode := :pi_details.cad_prod_code;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode THEN
 set_update_ITEMS;
 go_navigable_item; -- takes to the next navigable item in the screen.
 ELSE
 IF l_api_flag = 'Y' THEN
 go_navigable_item; -- takes to the next navigable item in the screen.
 ELSE
 go_next_null_item;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 RAISE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FINAL_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FINAL_CHECK(pl_suitProdCode IN VARCHAR2) IS
 CURSOR prd_cur IS
 SELECT NVL(suit_status_code, 'N'), cad_end_time, illumination_status, cad_start_time, prod_category, cad_prod_code, suit_prod_code
 FROM pathogen_reduction_details
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND suit_prod_code = NVL(pl_suitProdCode, suit_prod_code);

 
 CURSOR weld_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM component_interdictions
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id
 AND product_code = pl_suitProdCode
 AND inter_code = 'WELD'
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; 
 
 l_statusCode VARCHAR2(1);
 l_cadEndTime DATE;
 l_cadStartTime DATE;
 l_prodCategory VARCHAR2(10);
 l_illStatus VARCHAR2(1);
 l_recFound BOOLEAN := FALSE; 
 l_ILL_inserted BOOLEAN; 
 l_CAD_inserted BOOLEAN;
 l_cadProdCode VARCHAR2(8); 
 l_TRANSFER_complete BOOLEAN;
 l_suitProdCode VARCHAR2(8);
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
BEGIN
 
 BEGIN
 OPEN prd_cur;
 FETCH prd_cur INTO l_statusCode, l_cadEndTime, l_illStatus, l_cadStartTime, l_prodCategory, l_cadProdCode, l_suitProdCode;
 l_recFound := prd_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE prd_cur;
 
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 IF NVL(l_statusCode,'N') = 'Y' THEN 
 -- Completed Suitability Check. 
 IF NVL(l_illStatus, '0') = '1' THEN
 -- Illumination status is Complete.
 
 -- Check whether Illumination Bag is removed. For PLAS and PLT
 BEGIN
 l_ILL_inserted := sterile_inserted(:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, globalvar.c_illumination, l_suitProdCode);
 IF NOT l_ILL_inserted AND GLOBALVAR.l_PI_SEAL_RQ = 'Y' THEN
 show_error('0444'); -- Illumination Process is incomplete - Illumination Bag not removed.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 
 -- Check whether CAD START TIME is entered for PLT only. 
 BEGIN
 IF l_prodCategory = 'PLT' AND l_cadStartTime IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0445'); -- Illumination Process is incomplete - CAD start time not found.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;

 /*
 OPEN weld_cur;
 FETCH weld_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := weld_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE weld_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 show_error('0466'); --component has weld interdiction, cannot proceed.
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 */
 
 -- IM 257 
 -- check for inter;
 GLOBALVAR.l_unitID := :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id;
 GLOBALVAR.l_collDate := :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date;
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode := get_donor_code; 
 GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode := pl_suitProdCode;
 GLOBALVAR.l_prodType := get_prod_type;
 
 -- checks for unit level and SUIT component level.
 IF inter_found THEN
 show_error('0243');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 -- IM 275
 IF l_prodCategory = 'PLAS' AND 
 comp_rejected(p_unitID => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, p_collDate => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date , p_prodCode => pl_suitProdCode) THEN
 show_error('0243');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;

 IF l_cadProdCode IS NOT NULL THEN
 GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode := l_cadProdCode;
 GLOBALVAR.l_prodType := get_prod_type;
 -- checks for CAD component level only.
 IF cad_inter_found THEN
 show_error('0243');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 -- IM 275
 IF comp_rejected(p_unitID => :ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, p_collDate => :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date , p_prodCode => l_cadProdCode) THEN
 show_error('0005');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 ------------- 
 -- Cleared all checks. Allow to query.
 GO_BLOCK('pf_transfer');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(no_validate);
 EXECUTE_QUERY; 
 ELSE
 show_error('0427');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 show_error('0429');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 show_error('0426');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 
 END;
 
 :ctrl_pf_unit.chapter_ID := :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 
 

 BEGIN
 -- set items for PLASMA (No Top Block, No reject, no remove CAD)
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 item_change('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_date', 'D');
 item_change('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer.pb_reject', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad', 'D');
 disp_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.cad_bag_lbl', 'N');
 item_change('pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT', 'D');
 ELSE -- For Platelets
 item_change('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_date', 'E');
 item_change('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time', 'E');
 --enable_disable_item('pf_transfer.pb_reject', 'E'); -- initially disabled, so do not enable again.
 --enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad', 'E'); -- INITIALLY DISABLED.
 --disp_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.cad_bag_lbl', 'Y'); 
 item_change('pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT', 'E'); 
 END IF;

 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := FALSE;
 item_change('pf_products.S_PROD_CODE', 'E');
 item_change('pf_products.PROD_CODE', 'E');
 item_change('pf_products.S_VERIFY_PROD_CODE', 'E');
 item_change('pf_products.VERIFY_PROD_CODE', 'E'); 
 
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 -- Check if final process is completed or not.
 l_TRANSFER_complete := transfer_complete(:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, :ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code);
 
 IF l_TRANSFER_complete THEN -- :pf_transfer.final_prd_num_of_bags IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :FORMS_VAR.PRUP_ACCESS = 'N' THEN
 INIT_VIEW('PF_TRANSFER');
 show_error('0478');
 check_package_failure;
 
 ELSE
 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := TRUE; 
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pf_transfer_ctrl.PB_SAVE', LABEL, 'Update');
 
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save', 'E');
 --enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save', 'D');
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0'; 
 
 item_change('pf_products.S_PROD_CODE', 'D');
 item_change('pf_products.PROD_CODE', 'D');
 item_change('pf_products.S_VERIFY_PROD_CODE', 'D');
 item_change('pf_products.VERIFY_PROD_CODE', 'D');
 
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.s_prd_num_of_bags');
 END IF;
 --GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_reprint_label');
 --show_error('0465');--MESSAGE('Finished Pathogen Processing');
 --check_package_failure; 
 ELSE 
 --GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.final_prd_num_of_bags');
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save', 'E');
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.s_prd_num_of_bags');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF :pf_transfer.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 l_CAD_inserted := sterile_inserted(:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, globalvar.c_cad, l_suitProdCode);
 IF l_CAD_inserted THEN
 disp_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.cad_bag_lbl', 'Y'); 
 END IF; 
 -- Check if final process is completed or not.
 l_TRANSFER_complete := transfer_complete(:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, :ctrl_pf_unit.suit_prod_code);
 
 IF l_TRANSFER_complete THEN 
 IF :FORMS_VAR.PRUP_ACCESS = 'N' THEN
 INIT_VIEW('PF_TRANSFER');
 show_error('0478');
 check_package_failure;
 
 ELSE 
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('pf_transfer_ctrl.PB_SAVE', LABEL, 'Update');
 GLOBALVAR.lb_update_mode := TRUE;
 
 item_change('pf_products.S_PROD_CODE', 'D');
 item_change('pf_products.PROD_CODE', 'D');
 item_change('pf_products.S_VERIFY_PROD_CODE', 'D');
 item_change('pf_products.VERIFY_PROD_CODE', 'D');
 
 
 -- Allow only reprint label. Do not allow to save
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer.pb_reject', 'D'); 
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad', 'E');
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save', 'E'); 
 --enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad', 'D');
 --enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save', 'D');
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 
 
 
 --GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_reprint_label');
 GO_ITEM('PF_TRANSFER.S_CAD_END_TIME');
 --show_error('0465');--MESSAGE('Finished Pathogen Processing');
 --check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 -- Either process is incomplete OR product is rejected.
 -- Check if Product is rejected.
 IF comp_rejected(:ctrl_pf_unit.unit_id, :ctrl_pf_unit.coll_date, l_cadProdCode) THEN -- component is rejected;
 reject_items('D'); --disables bottom blocks. 
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save', 'D'); -- DO not allow to save as already rejected and saved.
 show_error('0465');--MESSAGE('Finished Pathogen Processing');
 check_package_failure;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 /**/IF :pf_transfer.cad_end_time IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer.s_cad_end_time');
 /**/ELSE -- CAD END TIME IS NOT NULL
 -- s_cad_end_date and s_cad_end_time fields are populated in POST-QUERY.
 -- maybe coming for entering platelet count.
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';

 DECLARE
 l_EARLY_LATE VARCHAR2(20);
 BEGIN
 cad_time_check(:pf_transfer.cad_start_time, :pf_transfer.cad_end_time, l_EARLY_LATE);

 IF l_early_late = 'EARLY' THEN
 :pf_transfer.s_cad_status := 'Too early to transfer the product, place back on CAD rotator'; 
 set_item_property( 'pf_transfer.s_cad_status', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'GREEN_REC' );
 -- Reject (disable reject items)
 reject_items(p_enable => 'N'); 
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save');
 ELSIF l_early_late = 'LATE' THEN
 :pf_transfer.s_cad_status := 'Exceeded CAD Time';
 set_item_property( 'pf_transfer.s_cad_status', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'RED_REC');
 enable_disable_item('pf_transfer.pb_reject','E');
 -- Reject (disable reject items)
 reject_items(p_enable => 'N'); 
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_save');
 ELSE
 :pf_transfer.s_cad_status := 'Ready';
 set_item_property( 'pf_transfer.s_cad_status', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'DEFAULT_REC');
 -- Reject (enable reject items)
 reject_items(p_enable => 'Y');
 
 
 
 GO_BLOCK('pf_products');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 
 
 IF :pf_products.prod_Code IS NOT NULL AND :pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('pf_products.FINAL_PLT_COUNT');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('pf_transfer_ctrl.pb_rem_cad');
 END IF;
 
 
 END IF;
 END;
 
 
 
 /**/END IF;

 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 RAISE ; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SUIT_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE suit_check IS
--- Check if Suitability check has already started or not.
 CURSOR suitCheck_cur IS
 SELECT cad_start_time, suit_status_Code, suit_prod_code
 FROM pathogen_reduction_details
 WHERE unit_id = :CTRL_UNIT.UNIT_ID
 AND NVL(initial_prod_code,'@#@#') = NVL(:ctrl_unit.prod_code,'@#@#');
 
 CURSOR sterile_dock_cur(pl_process VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM pathogen_sterile_docking
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND suit_prod_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code
 AND proc_code = pl_process;
 
 l_cadStartTime DATE;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN;
 l_suit_Status VARCHAR2(1);
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_suitProdCode VARCHAR2(10);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 OPEN suitCheck_cur;
 FETCH suitCheck_cur INTO l_cadStartTime, l_suit_status, l_suitProdCode;
 l_recFound := suitCheck_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE suitCheck_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN -- Record found in pathogen_reduction_details table. Allow to update the record based on the stage it is in.

 go_block('pr_details');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 
 /*
 IF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 item_change('pr_details.suspension_type', 'E');
 --item_change('pr_details.equip_type', 'E'); 
 item_change('pr_details.init_plt_count', 'E');
 item_change('pr_details.s_aggr_acc', 'E');
 item_change('pr_details.s_aggr_not_acc', 'E');
 ELSIF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 item_change('pr_details.suspension_type', 'D');
 item_change('pr_details.equip_type', 'D');
 item_change('pr_details.init_plt_count', 'D');
 item_change('pr_details.s_aggr_acc', 'D');
 item_change('pr_details.s_aggr_not_acc', 'D'); 
 END IF;
 */
 OPEN sterile_dock_cur(globalvar.c_suitability);
 FETCH sterile_dock_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := sterile_dock_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE sterile_dock_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN -- sterile record found.
 IF l_suit_status = 'Y' THEN
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_print_label', 'E');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_sterile_docking', 'E');
 enable_sterile_buttons;
 OPEN sterile_dock_cur(globalvar.c_psoralen);
 FETCH sterile_dock_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := sterile_dock_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE sterile_dock_cur;
 IF l_recFound THEN
 disp_item('pr_details_ctrl.psoralen_lbl', 'Y'); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- IM 256
 IF l_suitProdCode IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- store it in a variable;
 -- Used for updating suit prod code scenarios (we need to delete from components before udpating product code)
 GLOBALVAR.bu_prodCode := l_suitProdCode; 
 END IF;
 
 --
 /* Allowed to update in UPDATE mode.
 IF l_cadStartTime IS NOT NULL THEN -- Intermediate processing already started or finished - do not allow to update.
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_check_suitability', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_sterile_docking', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_rem_psoralen', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_reject','D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_pheri', 'D');
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_save', 'D'); 
 enable_disable_item('pr_details_ctrl.pb_print_label', 'E');
 GO_ITEM('pr_details_ctrl.pb_print_label');
 show_error('0432');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 */
 --END IF;
 ELSE --- -- Record NOT FOUND in pathogen_reduction_details table. Insert as a new record. 
 :pr_details.initial_prod_code := :ctrl_unit.prod_code;
 :pr_details.prod_category := :ctrl_unit.s_prod_cat;

 populate_cnt_wt_vol(pl_prodCat => :ctrl_unit.s_prod_cat, 
 pl_prodCode => :ctrl_unit.prod_code);

 -- 1) populate bleed times and disable fields..
 populate_bleed_times;
 
 -- IM 584 11/30/2017
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 
 :pr_details.process_date_time := chp_sysdate;
 ----
 
 -- 2) populate Equip Type from component_cgmp table if present otherwise use validation table.
 populate_equipType;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_ERROR_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Proc modified to fix the issue of application freezing.
-- On 03/01/2012 by Arun (IM 6852)
-- Modifief the logic to display messages like Transaction Committed etc. (14-mar-2012)
PROCEDURE show_error_local
 (
 error_cd IN VARCHAR2
 ,add_msg IN VARCHAR2 := ''
 )
IS
 text VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_audit_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_error_type VARCHAR2(1);
 usr_id VARCHAR2(30) := NAME_IN('banner.user_id');
 current_form VARCHAR2(60) := NAME_IN('system.current_form');
 user_err_error_cd VARCHAR2(80);
 user_err_unit_id VARCHAR2(80); 
 user_err_chapter_id VARCHAR2(80);
 user_err_coll_date VARCHAR2(20);
 user_err_component_prefix VARCHAR2(80);
 user_err_product_code VARCHAR2(20); 
 err_type VARCHAR2(10);
 err_text VARCHAR2(500);
 
 PROCEDURE disp_msg
 (
 temp_err_typ IN VARCHAR2
 ,err_typ IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Note '
 ,err_txt IN VARCHAR2
 )
 IS
 al_id ALERT;
 al_btn NUMBER :=0;
 BEGIN
 IF UPPER(temp_err_typ) = 'E'
 THEN
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('ERR_ALERT');
 ELSIF UPPER(temp_err_typ) = 'W'
 THEN
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('WNG_ALERT');
 ELSE
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('MSG_ALERT');
 END IF;
 
 IF temp_err_typ in ('E','e','m','w','W')
 THEN
 IF ID_NULL(al_id)
 THEN
 COPY('N','GLOBAL.accept');
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 MESSAGE('Enter Response',no_acknowledge);
 COPY(err_txt||'.','GLOBAL.error_message') ;
 CALL_FORM( LOWER('ERROR') ,NO_HIDE);
 ELSE
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY(al_id,TITLE,err_typ);
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY(al_id,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,err_txt);
 al_btn := SHOW_ALERT(al_id);
 IF UPPER(temp_err_typ) = 'W'
 THEN
 IF al_btn = ALERT_BUTTON1
 THEN
 COPY('Y','GLOBAL.accept');
 ELSE
 COPY('N','GLOBAL.accept');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 MESSAGE(err_txt);
 END IF;
 END disp_msg;
 
BEGIN
 SELECT error_type
 ,DECODE
 (
 error_type
 ,'E','Err:'||error_code
 ,'e','Err:'||error_code
 ,'M','Msg:'||error_code
 ,'m','Msg:'||error_code
 ,'W','Warn:'||error_code
 ,'w','Warn:'||error_code
 ,''||error_code
 )||': '||NVL(error,'Error missing')
 ,audit_flag
-- ,error_type
 ,DECODE
 (
 UPPER(error_type)
 ,'E','Error ! '
 ,'M','Message '
 ,'W','Warning ! '
 ,''
 )
 INTO temp_error_type
 ,text
 ,temp_audit_flag
 -- ,temp_error_type
 ,err_type
 FROM valid_errors_lab
 WHERE error_code = error_cd
 ;
 --
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.accept');
 
 if temp_error_type in ('e', 'm', 'w', 'W') then -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 IF add_msg IS NULL THEN
 err_text := text || '.';
 ELSE
 err_text := text || ' ' || add_msg || '.';
 END IF;
 synchronize; -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 disp_msg(temp_error_type, err_type, err_text);
 else -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 if add_msg is null then
 message(text || '.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 else
 message(text|| add_msg || '.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 end if;
 -- End of change 
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 
 IF temp_audit_flag = 'Y'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_SYSDATE');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');
 COPY(to_char(SYSDATE,'DD-MON-YY HH24:MI:SS'),
 'GLOBAL.user_err_SYSDATE');
 COPY(error_cd,'GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd'); 
 user_err_error_cd := NAME_IN('global.user_err_error_cd');
 user_err_unit_id := NAME_IN('global.user_err_unit_id'); 
 user_err_chapter_id := NAME_IN('global.user_err_chapter_id');
 user_err_coll_date := NAME_IN('global.user_err_coll_date');
 user_err_component_prefix := NAME_IN('global.user_err_component_prefix');
 user_err_product_code := NAME_IN('global.user_err_product_code'); 

 INSERT INTO user_error_log_tmp
 (
 insert_dats
 ,user_id
 ,program_name
 ,error_code
 ,unit_id
 ,chapter_id
 ,coll_date
 ,component_prefix
 ,product_code
 )
 VALUES
 (
 SYSDATE
 ,usr_id
 ,current_form
 ,user_err_error_cd
 ,user_err_unit_id
 ,user_err_chapter_id
 ,user_err_coll_date
 ,user_err_component_prefix
 ,user_err_product_code
 )
 ; 

 /* The user exit -user error was replaced by the local procedure by Edwin on 08.14.2001 to
 get rid of the user exits */
 COPY(current_form,'GLOBAL.user_err_prog_name');
 COPY(usr_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_user_id');
 GENERATE_USER_ERROR; -- Added by Kishore on 08/10/2011. SCR 18564
 IF NOT FORM_SUCCESS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('User exit to trap user error failed');
 END IF;
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL; 
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (NAME_IN('GLOBAL.accept')= 'N' OR 
 temp_error_type = 'E'
 ) AND 
 UPPER(temp_error_type) != 'M' 
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 MESSAGE( 'Err:No error description for error code '||error_cd);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 MESSAGE( 'Err:Too many descriptions for error code '||error_cd);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INTER_FOUND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION inter_found RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any unit level NFTs are present
 --
 cursor unit_inter_cur is
 select 1
 from unit_interdictions u, valid_interdictions_lab v 
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'N' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'N')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code = 
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate))
 
 UNION
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any unit level BIOs are present
 -- 
 select 1
 from unit_interdictions u, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'B' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'B')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate))
 UNION 
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any HOLD interdictions are present on unit
 -- 
 select 1
 from unit_interdictions u, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'H' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'H')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate));
 
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any component level NFTs are present
 --
 cursor comp_inter_cur is
 select 1
 from component_interdictions c, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode and
 c.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'N' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'N')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate))
 
 UNION
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any HOLDs are present on component
 -- 
 select 1
 from component_interdictions c, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode and
 c.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'H' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'H')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate)); 
 

 cursor override_cur is
 select 1 -- override_desc
 from valid_inter_overrides
 where donor_decision_code = GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and override_desc is not null
 and inter_type = 'I'
 and inter_code in
 (select inter_code
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode
 UNION
 select inter_code
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);


 l_unitInterFound BOOLEAN;
 l_compInterFound BOOLEAN;
 l_overRideFound BOOLEAN;
 l_interFound BOOLEAN := FALSE; -- Default is FALSE
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;

BEGIN
 OPEN unit_inter_cur;
 FETCH unit_inter_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_unitInterFound := unit_inter_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE unit_inter_cur;

 OPEN comp_inter_cur;
 FETCH comp_inter_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_compInterFound := comp_inter_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE comp_inter_cur;

 
 IF l_unitInterFound OR l_compInterFound THEN
 l_interFound := TRUE;
 
 OPEN override_cur;
 FETCH override_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_overRideFound := override_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE override_cur;
 
 IF l_overRideFound THEN
 l_interFound := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_interFound; 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROD_TYPE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_prod_type RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 l_prodType VARCHAR2(10) := NULL;
 
 CURSOR prodType_cur IS
 SELECT product_type
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = SUBSTR(GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode, 1, 5)
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 
BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 OPEN prodType_cur;
 FETCH prodType_cur INTO l_prodType;
 CLOSE prodType_cur;
 
 RETURN l_prodType;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_CODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_Donor_Code RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 CURSOR units_cur IS
 SELECT donor_decision_code
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID
 AND coll_date = GLOBALVAR.l_collDate;
 
 l_donorCode VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 OPEN units_cur;
 FETCH units_cur INTO l_donorCode;
 CLOSE units_cur;
