ProgramUnit.Name: CAD_INTER_FOUND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION cad_inter_found RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any component level NFTs are present
 --
 cursor comp_inter_cur is
 select 1
 from component_interdictions c, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode and
 c.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'N' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'N')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate))
 
 UNION
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any HOLDs are present on component
 -- 
 select 1
 from component_interdictions c, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode and
 c.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'H' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'H')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate)); 
 

 cursor override_cur is
 select 1 -- override_desc
 from valid_inter_overrides
 where donor_decision_code = GLOBALVAR.l_donorCode
 and product_type = GLOBALVAR.l_prodType
 and override_desc is not null
 and inter_type = 'I'
 and inter_code in
 (select inter_code
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = GLOBALVAR.l_prodCode
 UNION
 select inter_code
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = GLOBALVAR.l_unitID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(GLOBALVAR.l_collDate)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);


 l_unitInterFound BOOLEAN;
 l_compInterFound BOOLEAN;
 l_overRideFound BOOLEAN;
 l_interFound BOOLEAN := FALSE; -- Default is FALSE
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;

BEGIN

 OPEN comp_inter_cur;
 FETCH comp_inter_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_compInterFound := comp_inter_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE comp_inter_cur;

 
 IF l_compInterFound THEN
 l_interFound := TRUE;
 
 OPEN override_cur;
 FETCH override_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_overRideFound := override_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE override_cur;
 
 IF l_overRideFound THEN
 l_interFound := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 RETURN l_interFound; 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_SUIT_PROD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_SUIT_PROD IS
 -- Validate product code against valid_products table.
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 l_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN

 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);


 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO l_cnt
 FROM valid_products v
 WHERE v.product_code = SUBSTR(:pr_details.suit_prod_code,1,5)
 AND v.product_type IN 
 (
 SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 2))prod_code
 FROM valid_product_types vpt, master_codes mc
 WHERE vpt.product_type_code = TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 2))
 AND mc.code_type = 'PARDT'
 AND TRIM(regexp_substr(mc.code_desc,'[^:]+', 1, 1)) = :pr_details.prod_category
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN vpt.eff_date AND NVL(vpt.term_date, chp_SYSDATE+1)
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN mc.eff_date AND NVL(mc.term_date, chp_SYSDATE+1) 
 )
 AND NVL(v.pathogen_reduction_flag ,'N') = 'Y'
 AND v.unit_scheme_type = 'I' 
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN v.eff_date AND NVL(v.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 

 IF l_cnt = 0 THEN
 show_error('0439');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_INTENTED_USE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_intented_use IS
-- Validated if intended use is already entered.
 l_final_prodCode VARCHAR2(10);
 l_temp_prodCode VARCHAR2(10); 
BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.suit_prod_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(:pr_details.suit_prod_code) != 5 THEN
 l_temp_prodCode := SUBSTR(:pr_details.suit_prod_code,1,5);
 calculate_intented_use( in_unit_id => :ctrl_unit.unit_id, 
 temp_v_prod_code => l_temp_prodCode, 
 out_prod_code => l_final_prodCode);
 
 IF :pr_details.suit_prod_code <> l_final_prodCode THEN
 show_error('0439');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
END;

 -- Generate if intended use is not entered.
 l_final_prodCode VARCHAR2(10); 
BEGIN

 calculate_intented_use( in_unit_id => :ctrl_unit.unit_id, 
 temp_v_prod_code => :pr_details.suit_prod_code, 
 out_prod_code => l_final_prodCode);

 END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: TYPESET_FAIL_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE typeset_fail_check IS
 plt_cnt_fail BOOLEAN;
 prod_vol_fail BOOLEAN;
 BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 
 plt_cnt_fail := plt_typeset_fail('PLT_CNT'); -- returns true if failed OR false.
 prod_vol_fail := plt_typeset_fail('PROD_VOL');
 
 IF plt_cnt_fail AND prod_vol_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Platelet Count and Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF plt_cnt_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Platelet Count'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSIF prod_vol_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF; 
 ELSIF :pr_details.prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 prod_vol_fail := plas_typeset_fail('PROD_VOL'); 
 
 IF prod_vol_fail THEN
 show_error('0424', ' - Product Volume'); -- Type Set selected does not meet the required parameters
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 END typeset_fail_check;

ProgramUnit.Name: ITEM_CHANGE_MULTIRECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE item_change_multirecord (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2, p_color IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Y') IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 --set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id, INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 IF p_color = 'Y' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id, background_color,'r255g255b255');
 END IF;
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then
 set_item_property(it_id,UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 elsif p_mode = 'D' then
 set_item_property(it_id, UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property(it_id, INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property(it_id, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 IF p_color = 'Y' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id, background_color,'r192g192b192'); 
 END IF;
 --set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 --set_item_property(it_id, font_style, font_outline);
 --set_item_property(it_id, foreground_color,'r000g000b000'); 
 end if ;
 end if ;
END;

 process_code_in IN VARCHAR2,

 lb_checkPassed BOOLEAN;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLACE_WELD_ON_FINAL_PRODUCT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE place_weld_on_final_product(unit_id_in IN VARCHAR2,
 suit_prod_code_in IN VARCHAR2,
 process_code_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 FOR rec IN (
 SELECT
 product_code
 FROM
 pathogen_final_products
 WHERE
 unit_id = unit_id_in
 AND suit_prod_code = suit_prod_code_in
 ) LOOP
 place_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => rec.product_code);
 END LOOP;
 -- otherwise place inter on suit prod code.
 IF process_code_in <> GLOBALVAR.C_CAD THEN
 place_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => suit_prod_code_in);
 END IF;
END place_weld_on_final_product;

ProgramUnit.Name: REMOVE_WELD_ON_FINAL_PRODUCT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE remove_weld_on_final_product(unit_id_in IN VARCHAR2,
 suit_prod_code_in IN VARCHAR2,
 process_code_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
-- before deleting make sure that SEAL_OK is not 'N' in other places.
 ncnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT
 COUNT(1)
 INTO ncnt
 FROM
 pathogen_sterile_docking
 WHERE
 unit_id = unit_id_in
 AND suit_prod_code = suit_prod_code_in
 AND nvl(weld_ok, 'N') = 'N'
 AND proc_code <> process_code_in;

 IF ncnt = 0 THEN
 -- remove WELD on pathogen_final_products
 FOR rec IN (
 SELECT
 product_code
 FROM
 pathogen_final_products
 WHERE
 unit_id = unit_id_in
 AND suit_prod_code = suit_prod_code_in
 ) LOOP
 remove_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => rec.product_code);
 END LOOP;
 
 IF process_code_in <> GLOBALVAR.C_CAD THEN 
 -- remove WELD on suit_prod_code
 remove_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => suit_prod_code_in);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END remove_weld_on_final_product;

ProgramUnit.Name: SUITABILITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE SUITABILITY IS
 FUNCTION place_remove_weld_inter RETURN VARCHAR2;
 PROCEDURE update_initial_component_cvw;
 PROCEDURE populate_set_lot_no;
 PROCEDURE save_button_process;
 PROCEDURE update_button_process;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SUITABILITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY SUITABILITY IS
 FUNCTION place_remove_weld_inter RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 lv_place_remove_inter VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 IF (
 globalvar.rec_sterile_bu.weld_ok = 'Y'
 AND globalvar.rec_sterile_au.weld_ok = 'N'
 ) OR (
 globalvar.rec_bag_bu.seal_ok = 'Y'
 AND globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok = 'N'
 ) THEN
 lv_place_remove_inter := 'PLACE';
 ELSIF (
 globalvar.rec_sterile_bu.weld_ok = 'N'
 AND globalvar.rec_sterile_au.weld_ok = 'Y'
 ) OR (
 globalvar.rec_bag_bu.seal_ok = 'N'
 AND globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok = 'Y'
 ) THEN
 lv_place_remove_inter := 'REMOVE';
 END IF;

 RETURN lv_place_remove_inter;
 END place_remove_weld_inter;
 
 -- UPDATE initial product - count, volume, weight.
 PROCEDURE update_initial_component_cvw IS

 ln_comp_cnt NUMBER;
 ln_anticoag_vol NUMBER;
 ln_comp_weight NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE update_comp_count IS
 BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.init_plt_count IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE components
 SET
 component_count = :pr_details.init_plt_count * 10
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND substr(product_code, 1, 5) = substr(:ctrl_unit.prod_code, 1, 5);

 END IF;
 END update_comp_count;

 PROCEDURE update_comp_weight IS
 BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_weight IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE components
 SET
 component_weight = :pr_details.initial_prod_weight
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND substr(product_code, 1, 5) = substr(:ctrl_unit.prod_code, 1, 5);

 END IF;
 END update_comp_weight;

 PROCEDURE update_comp_volume IS
 BEGIN
 IF :pr_details.anticoagulant_volume IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE components
 SET
 anticoagulant_volume = :pr_details.anticoagulant_volume
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND substr(product_code, 1, 5) = substr(:ctrl_unit.prod_code, 1, 5);

 END IF;
 END update_comp_volume;

 BEGIN
 SELECT
 component_count,
 anticoagulant_volume,
 component_weight
 INTO
 ln_comp_cnt,
 ln_anticoag_vol,
 ln_comp_weight
 FROM
 components
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_unit.coll_date)
 AND substr(product_code, 1, 5) = substr(:ctrl_unit.prod_code, 1, 5); 
 
 -- Update components table if init plt count is updated.
 IF nvl(ln_comp_cnt, 0) <> nvl(:pr_details.init_plt_count, 0) THEN
 update_comp_count;
 END IF;

 -- Update components table if anticoagulant_volume is updated. 
 IF nvl(ln_anticoag_vol, 0) <> nvl(:pr_details.anticoagulant_volume, 0) THEN
 update_comp_volume;
 END IF;
 
 -- Update components table if component_weight is updated.
 IF nvl(ln_comp_weight, 0) <> nvl(:pr_details.initial_prod_weight, 0) THEN
 update_comp_weight;
 END IF;

 END update_initial_component_cvw;

 -- Populate set_id_lot_no
 PROCEDURE populate_set_lot_no IS

 CURSOR sterile_docking_cur IS
 SELECT
 set_lot_no
 FROM
 pathogen_sterile_docking
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND suit_prod_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code -- MLT 5421 (added suitability prod code check)
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_suitability;

 BEGIN
 OPEN sterile_docking_cur;
 FETCH sterile_docking_cur INTO :pr_details.set_id_lot_no;
 CLOSE sterile_docking_cur;
 END populate_set_lot_no;

 PROCEDURE save_button_process IS
 l_cnt NUMBER;
 l_amo_inserted BOOLEAN;
 lv_place_remove_weld_inter VARCHAR2(10) := NULL;
 BEGIN
 -- IM 275
 IF :pr_details.suit_prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 validate_suit_prod; -- validate suit prod against valid_products table
 validate_intented_use; -- if intented use is already entered.
 generate_intented_use; -- if intented use is not alrady entered.
 END IF;
 --

 IF :ctrl_unit.s_prod_cat = 'PLT' THEN
 IF :pr_details.suspension_type IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Suspension Type');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :pr_details.equip_type IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Equipment Type');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :pr_details.init_plt_count IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Initial Platelet Count');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 -- Required field check.
 IF :pr_details.vol_type_set IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Volume Type Set');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 typeset_fail_check;
 IF :ctrl_unit.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 SUITABILITY.update_initial_component_cvw;
 END IF;
 IF :pr_details.suit_prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- 2) Update sterile docking table if initial sterile docking window is updated.
 IF globalvar.sterile_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_machine = globalvar.rec_sterile_au.weld_machine,
 wafer_lot_no = globalvar.rec_sterile_au.wafer_lot_no,
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_sterile_au.weld_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_suitability
 AND suit_prod_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code;

 END IF;
 
 -- 3) Update sterile docking table is psoralen bag removal window is updated.
 IF globalvar.bag_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_psoralen
 AND suit_prod_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code;

 END IF;

 IF globalvar.sterile_update OR globalvar.bag_update THEN
 -- if sterile weld is updated from Y to N AND/OR bag seal is updated from Y to N, place interdiction.
 lv_place_remove_weld_inter := SUITABILITY.place_remove_weld_inter;
 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'PLACE' THEN
 place_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => :pr_details.suit_prod_code);
 -- Remove interdiction if sterile WELD is updated from N to Y and/OR bag seal is updated from N to Y. 
 ELSIF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'REMOVE' THEN
 -- remove WELD on suit_prod_code
 remove_weld_on_product(prod_code_in => :pr_details.suit_prod_code);
 END IF;

 END IF;
 
 -- check if suit product code is NOT NULL and check for discards(rejects).
 -- check if initial product code is NOT NULL and check for discards(rejects).-- IM 275
 -- Insert component only if suitability check is passed (if not passed - can go for PHERI).
 -- Insert component only if seal check is passed (configurable)
 IF
 NOT comp_rejected(p_unitid => :ctrl_unit.unit_id, p_colldate => :ctrl_unit.coll_date, p_prodcode => :pr_details.suit_prod_code
 )
 AND NOT comp_rejected(p_unitid => :ctrl_unit.unit_id, p_colldate => :ctrl_unit.coll_date, p_prodcode => :pr_details.initial_prod_code
 )
 AND nvl(:pr_details.suit_status_code, 'X') = 'Y'
 AND seal_check_passed(unit_id_in => :ctrl_unit.unit_id, process_code_in => globalvar.c_psoralen, suit_prod_code_in => :pr_details.suit_prod_code
 )
 THEN
 SELECT
 COUNT(1)
 INTO l_cnt
 FROM
 components
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_unit.coll_date
 AND product_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code;

 IF l_cnt = 0 THEN
 insert_comp(pl_unitid => :ctrl_unit.unit_id, pl_colldate => :ctrl_unit.coll_date, pl_prodcode => :pr_details.suit_prod_code
 , pl_catalog_no => NULL, pl_oldprodcode => :ctrl_unit.prod_code);
 -- IM 256
 IF
 globalvar.bu_prodcode IS NOT NULL
 AND globalvar.bu_prodcode <> :pr_details.suit_prod_code
 THEN -- UPDATE INTER PRODUCT scenario.
 delete_comp(pl_prodcode => globalvar.bu_prodcode);
 update_sterile(pl_newprodcode => :pr_details.suit_prod_code, pl_oldprodcode => globalvar.bu_prodcode);
 END IF;

 END IF;

 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter IS NULL THEN
 place_weld_inter(p_suitprodcode => :pr_details.suit_prod_code, p_weldprodcode => :pr_details.suit_prod_code, p_proccode => globalvar.c_suitability
 );
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END IF; -- Inter prod code not null;

 SUITABILITY.populate_set_lot_no;
 END save_button_process;

 PROCEDURE update_button_process IS
 lv_place_remove_weld_inter VARCHAR2(10) := NULL;
 BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_unit.s_prod_cat = 'PLT' THEN
 IF :pr_details.suspension_type IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Suspension Type');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :pr_details.equip_type IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Equipment Type');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :pr_details.init_plt_count IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Initial Platelet Count');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 IF :pr_details.initial_prod_weight IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Prod. Weight');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :pr_details.process_date_time IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', 'Process Date Time');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 typeset_fail_check;

 IF :ctrl_unit.prod_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 SUITABILITY.update_initial_component_cvw;
 END IF;
 
 -- 2) Update sterile docking table if initial sterile docking window is updated.
 IF globalvar.sterile_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_machine = globalvar.rec_sterile_au.weld_machine,
 wafer_lot_no = globalvar.rec_sterile_au.wafer_lot_no,
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_sterile_au.weld_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_suitability
 AND suit_prod_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code;

 END IF;

 -- 3) Update sterile docking table is psoralen bag removal window is updated.
 IF globalvar.bag_update THEN
 UPDATE pathogen_sterile_docking
 SET
 weld_ok = globalvar.rec_bag_au.seal_ok
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_unit.unit_id
 AND proc_code = globalvar.c_psoralen
 AND suit_prod_code = :pr_details.suit_prod_code;

 END IF;

 IF globalvar.sterile_update OR globalvar.bag_update THEN
 -- if sterile weld is updated from Y to N AND/OR bag seal is updated from Y to N, place interdiction.
 lv_place_remove_weld_inter := SUITABILITY.place_remove_weld_inter;
 IF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'PLACE' THEN
 place_weld_on_final_product(:ctrl_unit.unit_id, :pr_details.suit_prod_code, globalvar.c_suitability);
 -- Remove interdiction if sterile WELD is updated from N to Y and/OR bag seal is updated from N to Y. 
 ELSIF lv_place_remove_weld_inter = 'REMOVE' THEN
 remove_weld_on_final_product(:ctrl_unit.unit_id, :pr_details.suit_prod_code, globalvar.c_suitability);
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END update_button_process; 
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 CLEAR_MESSAGE;

 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209') then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in ('40735') then
 null;
 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;

 end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-FORM
Trigger.TriggerText:
--:global.program_version := '01'; -- New design
--:global.program_version := '02'; -- IM 226, IM 227, 228, 230 , 232 Fixed.
--:global.program_version := '03'; -- 
--:global.program_version := '04';
--:global.program_version := '05';
--:global.program_version := '06';
--:global.program_version := '07';
--:global.program_version := '08'; --IM fixes - 252,251,250,249,244,242,241,239,234
--:global.program_version := '09'; -- Check for interdictions logic added. IM 257
 -- IM 262
--:global.program_version := '10'; -- IM 269 place_weld_inter routine modified. 
--:global.program_version := '11'; -- IM 272 (calculated intended use parameters incorrect for pf_products) 
 -- IM 255 Intended use validation logic added.
 -- IM 265 CAD and intermediate prod code scannign added.
 -- IM 259 scanning added for intermediate product code.
 -- IM 264 Chk digit populated from query status screen, status query modified.
 -- IM 256 -- Updating product code functinality added.
 -- IM 261 -- code to validate lot number added in intermediate_check;
 -- IM 273 (same as IM 261)
 -- IM 263 -- Psoralen Bag removal check added.
 -- IM 271 -- Logic added to generate intended use if it is not generated already.
 -- IM 274 -- next_navigable_item routine modifed.
 -- IM 275 -- suit_prod_Code validation added in SAVE button.
 -- IM 276 -- populate default anticoagulant volume in final screen.

--:global.program_version := '12'; -- IM 275 
 /*
 SUIT screen:
 1) Do not allow product discarded (converted to INTER) to be displayed in LoV.
 2) Do not create INTER product if initial prod is rejected.
 INTER screen
 1) Do not allow product discarded (converted to CAD) to be displayed in LoV.
 2) Check for component rejection of SUIT product.
 3) Do not allow to save record without CAD Start time when CAD Prod Code is entered, otherwise user will not be able to go back and enter start time once CAD product is created.
 This requirement is for PLT category only. 
 FINAL screen
 1) No changes made to LoV as we need to allow user to come back and enter platelet count even after product is converted.
 2) Check for component rejection of CAD product for PLT category.
 3) Check for component rejection of SUIT product for PLAS category.
 */
 -- IM 280
 /*
 -- Validation checks added to INTER screen to validate api file data.
 */
-- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
--:global.program_version := '01';
--:global.program_version := '01'; -- valid_interdictions_lab

--:global.program_version := '02'; -- IM 315 -- BOM Marker removal logic modified.
--:global.program_version := '03'; -- SCR: 152021
--:global.program_version := '04'; -- Err code 0469 modified to 0243
--:global.program_version := '05'; -- IM 584

 begin
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_block_property(f_block,FIRST_ITEM);

 default_value('TRUE','global.show_hint');

 system_users.testing_lab_code,

 null;

 END;

 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := ''; --HCLC Code128

 lpad( :global.system_name, NVL(length(:global.system_name), 0) +
 floor((50 - NVL(length(:global.system_name), 0))/2),' ');
 :banner.module_name :=
 lpad( :global.module_name, NVL(length(:global.module_name), 0) +
 floor((50 - NVL(length(:global.module_name), 0))/2),' ');
--
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('banner.module_name','Bold-underline');
 :banner.prog_name := prog_name;
 
 --11g only
 /*
 if substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,4) = 'OPS$'
 then
 :banner.user_id := substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5,6) ;
 else
 :banner.user_id := substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,6) ;
 end if;
 */
 --10g only
 if substr(user,1,4) = 'OPS$'
 then
 :banner.user_id := substr(user,5,6) ;
 else
 :banner.user_id := substr(user,1,6) ;
 end if;
 --
--
 default_value ('N/A','global.db_id');
 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,1))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;

 when others then handle_error;

 end if;

 :banner.colon := ':';
--
 
end ;
